entries.title: Designing New Traditions
entries.summary: Guidance for building your own Infernal traditions out of Methods, Powers and other Favored Abilities, including how new Powers and Methods must be linked.
quotes: New Powers must be associated with at least one Method, and a new Method must be associated with at least two Powers.

entries.title: True Name of (Being)
entries.summary: Explains that a True Name is learned through Realm Lore study and lets the character affect a being as if with a permanent Arcane Connection.
quotes: the character can affect it as if she had a permanent Arcane Connection to it

entries.title: Elementalist Characters (Arts, vis use and study)
entries.summary: Elementalist magic uses four Techniques and four Forms that work only in combination and come in Medicinal, Philosophical and Theurgical types; it also covers how elementalists add vis to totals and study their Arts from vis or books.
quotes: receiving a +2 bonus for each pawn of vis that corresponds to the Elementalist Form used in the formula
spend a number of pawns of vis associated with that Form equal to (their score in the Technique / 2), rounded up

related.text: Hedge Magic: Acquiring Hedge Wizard Powers

entries.title: Other Summoning Arts
entries.requires: Elementalist who also has infernal Summoning
entries.summary: Distinguishes elementalist (Elemental) Summoning from infernal (Spirit) Summoning, and which of Controlling and Commanding works on elementals, spirits or both.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.87, 114-115

entries.title: Elementalist Forms
entries.summary: Introduces the four Elementalist Forms and what they can affect depending on the paired Technique type.

entries.title: Elementalist Air
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what Medicinal, Philosophical and Theurgical elementalists can affect with air and gives a Soak bonus from the Sanguine Trait against air damage.
quotes: The character adds his Sanguine Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of air

entries.title: Elementalist Earth
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with earth and gives a Soak bonus from the Melancholy Trait against earth damage.
quotes: The character adds his Melancholy Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of earth

entries.title: Elementalist Fire
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with fire and gives a Soak bonus from the Choleric Trait against fire damage.
quotes: The character adds his Choleric Trait to his Soak whenever he is damaged by the element of fire

entries.title: Elementalist Water
entries.summary: A Difficult Art; defines what elementalists can affect with water and gives a Soak bonus from the Phlegmatic Trait against water damage.
quotes: The character adds his Phlegmatic trait to his Soak when he is damaged by the element of water

entries.title: Elementalist Techniques
entries.summary: Introduces the four Elementalist Techniques, each tied to a Characteristic, combined with a Form and applied to a Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical target.

entries.title: Elementalist Summoning
entries.summary: The Summoning roll draws elements or targets to the elementalist at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level; the Total is looked up on a Size/Might chart, multiple Forms use the lowest score, summoning containers hold targets and ease later effects, and botches lose control.
quotes: SUMMONING TOTAL: stress die + Stamina + Summoning + (Form) + aura
This procedure always costs the elementalist a long-term Fatigue level

entries.title: Summoning (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician touches a target to cure or cause disease by shifting its humors, with the Summoning Total giving the strength of the disease in terms of wound and illness severity.
quotes: one magnitude more affects a disease equivalent to a Medium wound or a serious illness

entries.title: Summoning (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher conjures raw natural phenomena or base matter, or native animals of a fitting temperament, within the Size and Might limits set by the Summoning Total.
quotes: of an amount no more than the Size indicated by the Summoning Total on the chart earlier

entries.title: Summoning (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist brings an elemental into being from raw base material, with the Summoning Total setting its maximum Might; the elemental is permanent but cannot recover Might except by consuming vis.
quotes: Elementals are permanently summoned, but do not recover their Might Points over time unless they consume vis

entries.title: Elementalist Controlling
entries.summary: Controlling lets an elementalist dictate the behavior of summoned or encountered targets; it costs an ordinary Fatigue level, takes a round, must penetrate Magic Resistance, and is much easier against a bound target.
quotes: CONTROLLING TOTAL: stress die + Presence + Controlling + (Form) + aura

entries.title: Controlling (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician inspires or suppresses emotions as a temporary Personality Trait scaled to the Controlling Total, and can command supernatural creatures lodged in a human body.
quotes: roughly equivalent to a Personality Trait with a positive or negative value of (Controlling Total / 10), rounded up

entries.title: Controlling (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher can boost his Soak against a material of the matching element and give commands to animals of the matching temperament.
quotes: He may add his (Controlling Total / 5) to his Soak against the target material for as long as he maintains concentration

entries.title: Controlling (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist who equals or exceeds a being's Might can force it to carry out a single command, or banish an elemental permanently.
quotes: assuming he can equal or exceed the being's Might on his Controlling roll

entries.title: Elementalist Divining
entries.summary: Divining costs no Fatigue and either senses an appropriate target nearby (Size only) or, by touch, communes with it (Size and Might, and penetration); it can also locate vis of an element and uses the lower Form when several are combined.
quotes: Divining Total: stress die + Perception + Divining + (Form) + aura

entries.title: Divining (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician diagnoses humoral imbalance and, by tending a patient through recovery, adds a fraction of the Divining Total as magical aid to the patient's recovery roll.
quotes: treat his (Divining Total / 5) as magical aid for the purposes of the target's recovery roll

entries.title: Divining (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher senses natural materials of an element and animals of the matching temperament, including understanding an animal's thoughts by touch.

entries.title: Divining (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist senses beings with Might of the element in the region and can converse with them or perceive their past by touch.

entries.title: Elementalist Refining
entries.summary: A season-long laboratory-like activity that purifies or breaks down a target, often yielding raw vis; it also lets an elementalist brew a longevity potion costing vis scaled to his age.
quotes: REFINING TOTAL: Intelligence + (associated Ability) + Refining + (Form) + aura
The potion gives him a bonus to his Aging rolls equal to his (Refining Total /5)
costs a number of pawns of vis equal to his (age /5), rounded up

entries.title: Refining (Medicinal)
entries.summary: An elemental physician can make longevity potions for others and a year-long vigor potion that boosts a Characteristic chosen by Element, capped by his lowest Form; a table lists the Characteristics per element.
quotes: This boosts one of the target's Characteristics (as shown below) by the elementalist's (Refining Total / 5)

entries.title: Refining (Philosophical)
entries.summary: An elemental philosopher extracts vis from an aura, drains or boosts the Might of supernatural animals for vis, and moves vis between objects, losing half if the Form must be changed.
quotes: producing his (Refining Total / 10) in vis associated with the appropriate one of the four elements
his Refining Total for the season must equal or exceed (the total number of pawns of vis moved x 5)

entries.title: Refining (Theurgical)
entries.summary: An elemental theurgist restores Might to, or drains it from, an elemental or supernatural being depending on whether the Form matches, opposes or is unrelated to its own, producing vis from surplus or lost Might.
quotes: this is the number of Might Points restored to it

entries.title: Elementalist Societies (and Opening the Gift)
entries.summary: Societies teach particular Techniques and Forms; a Gifted member opens a Gifted student's Gift using a specific Opening Total, and the society's Arts indicate what unGifted initiates can be taught.
quotes: OPENING TOTAL: Intelligence + highest Technique + lowest Form + aura

entries.title: The Hyperborean Hymns of Apollo (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the hymns, the sacred names taught by Apollo, whose power derives from the Magic realm rather than the Divine.
quotes: although their power derives from the Magic realm, not the Divine.

entries.title: Performing the Hyperborean hymns
entries.requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (The Gift or Virtue: Hyperborean Hymnist)
entries.summary: Each hymn is learned as its own Supernatural Ability, and only Gifted characters or those with the Hyperborean Hymnist Virtue can recite a hymn successfully; Hermetic magi can study discovered hymns only for Insight.
quotes: Only characters with The Gift or with the Virtue Hyperborean Hymnist can ever successfully recite a hymn and gain the supernatural powers it provides.

related.text: ArM5 p.166 learning multiple Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Supernatural Ability: Hyperborean Hymn
entries.summary: Each hymn is a separate Supernatural Ability: every level gives levels of powers, adds to Soak against the hymn's principles, and can be added to a Lab Total when the hymn is involved in the effect or item.
quotes: For each level of a Hymn Ability, your character gains 15 levels of powers (see below for details).
Hymns may be also used in the laboratory, by adding the Ability to your character's Lab Total if the hymn involves either the effect or item being enchanted.

entries.title: Dead Language: Hyperborean
entries.summary: The Hyperborean language, understood by spirits and related to Ancient Greek; it aids hymn recitation but is not required, and its alphabet needs a separate level of Artes Liberales.
quotes: everyday usage, poetry, religious usage, talking to spirits.

entries.title: Reciting the Hymns
entries.summary: How a hymnist infuses a Power: a season of contemplation, then a recitation total against an Ease Factor derived from the Power's level. Once infused the Power is used at will and invoked with a brief prayer, with no gestures; includes a worked example.
quotes: Hymn Recitation Total: Communication + Hymn Ability + modifiers + aura
Hymn Recitation Ease Factor: (total level of Power(s) + Power level modifiers) / 3

entries.title: Puissant hymns and hymn Affinities
entries.summary: Affinity with Ability and Puissant Ability can be taken for a hymn; Puissant raises recitation and Soak totals but does not increase the points for Powers.
quotes: Puissant Hymn effectively increases your hymn recitation totals for that hymn, and other totals that may use your character's Hymn Ability score (such as Soak).

entries.title: Apollonian Personality Traits
entries.summary: Guidance on which Personality Traits Apollo favors and disfavors, used for Dutybound characters and Illumination.
quotes: Apollo symbolized a number of virtuous Personality Traits, the most prominent one being Austerity.

entries.title: Finding hymns, the Easy Way
entries.summary: A season-long stress roll to track down a hymn teacher, fragment or relic as a shortcut to a full adventure, with outcomes for failure and botch.
quotes: Finding a Hyperborean Hymn Source: Intelligence + Magic Lore + stress die vs. Ease Factor 21

entries.title: Recitation Total Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to a hymn recitation total: devotional behavior, distraction, Descent, knowing the language, and honorable or dishonorable Personality Flaws.
quotes: Devotional behavior means spending a season prior to reciting the hymn in activity devoted to the veneration of Apollo.

entries.title: Hymn Powers
entries.summary: How hymn Powers are designed: levels are set with the Hermetic guidelines and effect modifiers, the Ease Factor to recite is a fraction of the level, and hymns need no vis or Rituals even for permanent effects.
quotes: The Ease Factor to recite a hymn is determined by dividing the level of the Power by three (round up).

entries.title: Learning to Speak Hyperborean
entries.summary: Ways a character can acquire the Hyperborean language: similarity to Ancient Greek, decoding paired prayers, or instruction from Hyperborean ghosts and spirits.
quotes: knowing Ancient Greek allows limited understanding of Hyperborean.

entries.title: Gaining New Powers and Improving Existing Ones
entries.summary: Raising a Hymn Ability grants more levels of powers that can be spent on new Powers or on improving old ones, each requiring a recitation season; includes a worked example.
quotes: Each time you increase one of your character's Hymn Ability scores, he gains 15 additional levels in powers.

entries.title: Gaining More Levels (hymns and vis)
entries.summary: Hymnists can exceed the practical limit on powers per hymn by spending vis during a recitation, one extra level per pawn, with a suggested adjustment for high-vis sagas.
quotes: For each pawn of vis expended during the recitation of a hymn, the character gains one extra level to spend on Powers.

entries.title: The Seven Beautiful Names of Light: principles and invocation
entries.summary: Introduces the seven surviving hymns, the idea of principles (the hymn equivalent of Forms, relevant to Magic Resistance), the Magic Resistance power common to all hymns, and the longer invocation time at night.
quotes: During the nighttime the hymn takes longer to invoke: 15 minutes per point of the Ease Factor.

entries.title: Hymn: Azai (Beautiful Light)
entries.summary: The hymn of life, authority and vitality, and its list of principles (what its Powers can affect and their related Hermetic Forms for Magic Resistance).
quotes: Corpus: birth, the heart, vitality

entries.title: Hymn: Eloure (Fire Delighter)
entries.summary: The hymn of emotion, water and fertility, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: emotions, dreams, honesty, maternal urges

entries.title: Hymn: Iaó (Fire Feeler)
entries.summary: The hymn of senses, pleasure and beauty, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: affection, attraction, creativity, pleasure

entries.title: Hymn: Óai (Light Breather)
entries.summary: The hymn of intellect, animals, secrecy and travel (including the spirit world), and its principles.
quotes: Animal: birds, crows, dolphins, grasshoppers, hawks, mice, snakes, swans, wolves

entries.title: Hymn: Pentiterouni (Firewalker)
entries.summary: The hymn of discipline, the body, earth and stern authority, and its principles.
quotes: Corpus: aging and growth, bones, the organs and flesh, skin, trembling

entries.title: Hymn: Psyrinpheu (Fire Breather)
entries.summary: The hymn of passion, war and victory, and its principles.
quotes: Corpus: fevers, the head, muscles, sexuality, stamina, youth

entries.title: Hymn: Semesilam (Encloser, Lightmaker)
entries.summary: The hymn of the arts, justice, optimism and prosperity, and its principles.
quotes: Mentem: benevolence, justice, morality, optimism

entries.title: Hyperborean Choirs (overview)
entries.summary: Singing hymns in a choir is the only way to use more than one hymn at once, and requires the Supernatural Ability Ceremony.
quotes: singing hymns in a choir is the only way to use more than one Hyperborean hymn at once.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.34 Ceremony

entries.title: Choir Mechanics
entries.summary: How a choir of hymnists produces a one-off free-form effect: a focus character, a storyguide-set Ease Factor, extra level per additional hymn, members adding Communication plus Hymn Ability, a day or more of trance, and a vis cost equal to the Ease Factor.
quotes: Each member of the choir then adds his Communication + Hymn Ability to the focus character's recitation total.
If the effect calls on more than one hymn, increase the level of the Power by 5 for every extra hymn it requires.

entries.title: Choir Recitation Modifier
entries.summary: Table of bonuses to a choir recitation for spending longer than a day performing the hymn, up to a stated maximum.
quotes: This is the maximum bonus possible.

entries.title: Choir Example
entries.summary: A worked example of six hymnists using a choir to call down a plague, showing the Ease Factor, vis cost and Ceremony Bonus calculation.
quotes: The focus character's recitation total is 8 (Communication 2 + Hymn Iaó 6) with a Ceremony Bonus of 25

entries.title: Ansuz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ansuz governs speech, communication and sound, mostly Imaginem or Mentem as a target. Guidelines give Communication bonuses, recognising audible illusions, speech, perceiving Might and surface thoughts.
quotes: The target receives a bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of the effect to all Ability rolls associated with Communication.

entries.title: Berkanan Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Berkanan is the rune of healing, fertility and youth. Guidelines scale recovery bonuses, fertility control, and healing or preventing the natural healing of Light through Incapacitating wounds.
quotes: recovery rolls equal to (the magnitude of the effect x 3)

entries.title: Dagaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Dagaz governs time, day-long activities and growth. Guidelines cover bonuses to day-long Ability rolls and Aging rolls, size changes with the sun, rapid maturity and aging.
quotes: Aging rolls equal to the magnitude of the effect

entries.title: Ehwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ehwaz governs horses, mounted combat, speed and trust. Guidelines give bonuses on mounted rolls, Quickness rolls and trust rolls, plus taming, summoning a mount and changing Quickness.
quotes: bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of the effect on all rolls performed while mounted

entries.title: Fehu Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Fehu governs common wealth such as cattle, silver and grain. Guidelines give bonuses to wealth-gaining Ability rolls, detect precious metal or domestic animals, and summon wealth.
quotes: Ability rolls that support the target gaining wealth

entries.title: Gebo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Gebo governs gifts, debt and obligation, and acts as a Mentem influence. Guidelines give social-influence bonuses and escalating levels of deference, simple and complex commands, and domination.
quotes: bonus or penalty equal to the magnitude of this effect on all Ability rolls to influence others

entries.title: Hagalaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Hagalaz governs destructive weather and hail, mostly Auram or Aquam. Guidelines give Damage bonuses, a general hail attack and summoning or intensifying storms.
quotes: inflicting damage equal to a stress die + (the Level of the effect – 15)

entries.title: Isa Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Isa governs ice, cold and cold emotions. Guidelines give bonuses to cold-related rolls, a chilling Damage effect, freezing or melting water, apathy, holding a target motionless and icing a surface.
quotes: Chill a target, doing Damage equal to (the level of the effect – 20)

entries.title: Jera Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Jera governs harvest and year-long endeavours, mostly Herbam. Guidelines give a bonus to year-long activities paid out at year end, immunity to supernatural disease, lasting health and summoning food and drink.
quotes: year-long activities, so long as the rune lasts for the entire year
Target is immune to supernatural diseases of up to this effect

entries.title: Kauno Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Kauno governs fire, heat, fever and burning pain. Guidelines give disease-related roll bonuses, a scale of burning Damage per round by level and flammability, and illnesses from sores up to terminal that block natural healing.
quotes: recovery rolls due to sickness and disease equal to
This does +5 Damage to the target or anything touching it each round.

entries.title: Laguz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Laguz governs water, especially the ocean, mostly Aquam. Guidelines give bonuses to rolls in or on water, seeing through water, summoning water, breathing water, speeding sea journeys and waves.
quotes: Ability rolls performed while submerged in or floating upon water

entries.title: Mannaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Mannaz governs mankind and cooperation, usually Corpus, and is often used to target a person for another rune. Guidelines give Dexterity and group-work bonuses, cooperation, and Dexterity changes.
quotes: Ability rolls that involve Dexterity (but not Attack rolls)

entries.title: Naudiz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Naudiz governs hardship and need. Guidelines give bonuses when in great need, a bonus or penalty on retried Abilities, delaying another supernatural effect, binding an active rune spell, and despair that blocks Confidence.
quotes: Bind an active rune spell of Level less than or equal to this one

entries.title: Ingwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ingwaz governs family, home and security, tied to Herbam, Terram or Corpus. Guidelines give bonuses to family and household rolls, sensing family, easy childbirth and summoning a person.
quotes: Ability rolls that affect his family, household, or home

entries.title: Othila Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Othila governs inherited property such as lands and heirlooms, tied to Terram. Guidelines give bonuses to rolls using a specific heirloom tool, improving an object to exceptional quality, and summoning small objects.
quotes: The object functions as if it were exceptional quality, and reduces the number of potential botch dice by two when used.

entries.title: Perth Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Perth governs chance, secrets and the supernatural, tied to Vim. Guidelines give bonuses on chance rolls, adjusting botch dice, dispelling weaker effects, and sensing auras, vis and magic users.
quotes: the number of potential botch dice is reduced or increased by the magnitude of this effect
less than or equal to half this effect

entries.title: Raido Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Raido governs travel, carts, ships and planning. Guidelines give bonuses to travel Ability rolls, Stamina-based rolls and Initiative, repairs, sense of direction, doubling travel speed, Stamina changes and summoning large objects.
quotes: all Ability rolls made while traveling, such as Area Lore, Folk Ken, Ride, or Charm

entries.title: Sowilo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Sowilo governs light and the sun, tied to Ignem and the Divine. Guidelines give Perception bonuses, seeing through illusions, darkvision, sensing auras, darkness, invisibility, cold resistance and sunlight.
quotes: natural Ability rolls associated with Perception

entries.title: Tiwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Tiwaz governs truth, justice and battle for companions, tied to Mentem. Guidelines give bonuses to positive Personality rolls and Attack or Defense, a Confidence boost, and sensing people, motives, and lies.
quotes: as long as his Confidence Score is no greater than (the magnitude of this effect – 3)

entries.title: Thurisaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Thurisaz governs ogres, thorns, evil and shapeshifting, tied to Vim and Herbam. Guidelines give bonuses to negative Personality rolls, reducing supernatural Might, brambles, destroying plants and transformations between living and nonliving things.
quotes: Might Score is reduced by (the level of this effect – 10)

entries.title: Uruz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Uruz governs strength, endurance and wild animals, tied to Animal and Auram. Guidelines give Strength bonuses, Encumbrance changes, immunity to lesser mind effects, Strength changes and summoning wild animals by Size at escalating levels.
quotes: The target's Encumbrance is increased or decreased by the magnitude of this effect

entries.title: Wunjo Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Wunjo governs joy, comfort and glory, a Mentem rune for emotions. Guidelines give Presence-based bonuses, reducing Fatigue or Wound Penalties, powerful emotions, ignoring all such penalties and Presence changes.
quotes: Wound Penalties by (the magnitude of this effect x 3)

entries.title: Ihwaz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Ihwaz governs yew trees, bows, the dead and graves. Guidelines give Intelligence bonuses, sensing and summoning supernatural beings by Might, sensing plants and corpses, animating and summoning corpses, speaking with the dead and summoning a tree.
quotes: Summon a supernatural being with Might Score less than or equal to (the level of this effect – 10).

entries.title: Algiz Rune Guidelines
entries.summary: Algiz is the protection rune, used with a secondary rune. Guidelines adjust Soak and ward away supernatural targets or things of the secondary rune.
quotes: Soak is increased or decreased by the effect

entries.title: Vitkir as Characters
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir (The Gift, apprenticed rune master)
entries.summary: Character creation for vitkir: designed like magi with The Gift, a long apprenticeship in the 24 runes, set starting experience and rune script levels, minimum Abilities, virtue and flaw limits, and the Vitki Social Status.
quotes: They receive a total of 240 experience points for these years of specialized study
120 levels of rune scripts
A score of 10 in a single rune is the practical maximum for a character who has just finished his apprenticeship.

entries.title: Vitkar Magic Foci
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir; Virtue: Major or Minor Rune Focus
entries.summary: Explains how a vitkar magic focus works: the rune score is doubled for spells of the focus' purpose carved into its proper material. Lists the seven Sigrdrifumal types of rune magic with their materials and typical runes.
quotes: he may double his score in the rune used in the spell formula

entries.title: Craft: Runes
entries.summary: New Ability covering carving or inscribing runes into materials; it affects how long runes last and how well they can be hidden in a script.
quotes: This can be used to determine how long the runes last

entries.title: Rune Magic Ability
entries.summary: New Arcane Ability representing knowledge of vitkar magic and how to formulate rune scripts; interchangeable with the Ancient Magic Ability of the same name.
quotes: It deals with the technical details of each rune, how they may be used, and how to formulate a rune script.

entries.title: Nátt-thel
entries.summary: The vitkar equivalent of Twilight: after a sudden burst of Warping Points a vitki rolls to avoid temporarily losing The Gift and his magic, and a duration roll sets how long he is without it. A vitki may sacrifice extra Warping Points to keep some rune effects active.
quotes: Stamina + Concentration + stress die vs. (Warping Score x 3)
simple die + Warping Score

entries.title: Learning Vitkar Magic
entries.summary: How a master opens the runes for a laering, including the Opening Total and possible deficiencies, and how vitkir study runes from books, teachers, adventures, exposure and raw vis brewed into a potion.
quotes: Opening Total is his Intelligence + Rune Magic + lowest rune + aura

entries.title: Vitkar Magic: How Rune Spells Work
entries.summary: Overview of rune magic: runes inscribed in a material cause true natural changes that last as long as the inscription, do not trigger Magic Resistance, cause Warping, and make the carved object an Arcane Connection to the vitki.
quotes: the target of the rune spell is not considered a magical thing, and does not trigger Magic Resistance
The target also experiences Warping from rune spells of Level 30 or greater, unless the vitki casts the effect on himself.

related.text: ArM5 p.162 Opening the Intangible Tunnel

entries.title: Vitkar Rune Scripts
entries.summary: Vitkir cannot cast spontaneously and must invent rune scripts in advance, each using one of three methods that include the vitki's name and a description of effect and/or target.
quotes: Vitkir typically know many scripts, since they cannot perform their magic spontaneously.

entries.title: Rune Script Method I
entries.summary: A first-person script affecting the vitki or the object the runes are drawn on; it needs only a single rune because the target is implied.
quotes: This formula only requires a single rune, since the target is implied

entries.title: Rune Script Method II
entries.summary: A third-person script affecting some other target with an Arcane Connection or within about ten paces of the runes; uses two runes and the lower of the two scores.
quotes: The vitki always uses the lowest of his scores in these runes

entries.title: Rune Script Method III and Vitkar Lab Total
entries.summary: Method III creates a substitute Arcane Connection to a target. The section also gives the Vitkar Lab Total used to invent rune scripts in a season, and how scripts can be learned from a teacher.
quotes: (lowest) Rune + Intelligence + Rune Magic + Aura Modifier
the vitki gains a number of spell levels equal to his Lab Total

entries.title: Casting Rune Spells
entries.summary: The vitkar casting procedure: inscribe the script, roll the Casting Total against the script level for success or fatigue loss, and adjust for hurried, hidden, emphasised or vis-boosted inscriptions.
quotes: stress die + Stamina + (Iowest) Rune + Aura Modifier
gives him a -5 penalty
increases the Casting Total of the effect by 2 per pawn

entries.title: The Runes: Effects and Bonuses
entries.summary: Introduces the 24 runes as Accelerated Abilities, how rune effects grant non-stacking bonuses or penalties to rolls, and how to convert Hermetic guidelines into rune effects by adding magnitudes.
quotes: a good rule of thumb is to add four magnitudes to the effect

entries.title: Rune Casting Variations
entries.summary: Table of Casting Total modifiers for hiding or omitting the name or description, extra effort, emphasis and vis.
quotes: | Hidden name | -2 |

entries.title: The Older Futhark (Rune Table)
entries.summary: Lists the 24 runes of the Elder Futhark by aett (Freya, Heimdall, Tyr), with each letter, name, meaning and the effects it governs.
quotes: The three aetts of the Elder Futhark are named after three gods

entries.title: Modified Runes (Younger Futhark and Futhorc)
entries.requires: Tradition: Vitkir (Younger Futhark or Anglo-Saxon Futhorc)
entries.summary: Variant rune alphabets that use the same magic system: the Younger Futhark has fewer runes, so fewer are opened at the start; the Futhorc has more characters, which dilutes experience and power.
quotes: The magic of the Younger Futhark uses only 16 of the 24 runes (as shown in the insert)

entries.title: The Anglo-Saxon Futhorc
entries.summary: Reference table of the extended Anglo-Saxon rune alphabet, giving each rune's name, pronunciation, meaning and the Elder Futhark rune it corresponds to, with five runes that have no Elder equivalent.
quotes: Scholars agree that it included the first 28 runes

entries.title: The Younger Futhark
entries.summary: Reference table for the 16-rune Younger Futhark, listing the Elder Futhark runes that are missing and how each remaining rune maps to its Elder equivalent.
quotes: the runemasters eventually settled on a set of 16 runes instead of the original 24

entries.title: Debauchery (Ability)
entries.summary: The Unholy Method of focusing will through a strenuous physical act, at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound, using Stamina for the maleficium roll.
quotes: calls upon her Stamina for the maleficium roll

entries.title: Incantation (Ability)
entries.summary: The Unholy Method of invoking Infernal power through chanted or written blasphemy, adding Communication to the roll and costing a Confidence point.
quotes: requires that he spend a point of Confidence to call the effect into being

entries.title: Maleficia (Infernal casting)
entries.requires: Infernalist with a Method and a Power
entries.summary: Core rules for casting Infernal effects: combine a Method and a Power in a stress-die total against a target level, with failures costing botches and Warping, Hierarchy softening the consequences, a season to secure a soul after a botch, and the Vengeful Powers penalty for selfless use.
quotes: Maleficium: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura bonus
Treat a failed roll as one botch for each ten levels or fraction thereof that the infernalist is lacking.
The infernalist may substitute his (Hierarchy Score x 10) for his Maleficium Total

entries.title: Infernal Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: New spell parameters for maleficia: Range Crossroads, Duration Cursed (condition), Duration Forsaken and Target Passion, each with its equivalent magnitude.
quotes: Range Crossroads is considered the same level as Range Voice.
Duration Forsaken is the same level as Duration Year
Target Passion is the same level as Target Group

related.text: ArM5 p.92 Faerie Magic Range: Road

entries.title: Debauchery (Unholy Method)
entries.summary: The Method of casting a maleficium through a corrupting ritual that costs a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound, using Stamina, and that can be extended over hours or a whole season to build up Confidence spending or add Infernal Lore.
quotes: This uses the character's Stamina with the maleficium roll.

entries.title: Example: Richard of Glastonbury (maleficium)
entries.summary: A worked example of building and casting a maleficium, computing a casting total, rolling a possible botch and spending Confidence to limit the damage.
quotes: This is a base 15 Incantation/Diablerie effect

entries.title: Powerful Maleficia
entries.summary: Lists the ways an infernalist can boost a maleficium total: Ceremony, Confidence, Hierarchy, Sacrifice and vis, and that they can be combined.

entries.title: Incantation (Unholy Method)
entries.summary: The Method of casting through chanted words, using Communication, costing a Confidence Point or a Warping Point, and allowing infernal vis to boost the casting total.
quotes: Each pawn of vis he expends while casting the maleficium gives him a +2 bonus to his casting total
The number of pawns he can use in a single maleficium is limited to his (Incantation + Power).

entries.title: New Methods and Powers
entries.summary: Guidance for storyguides on designing additional Methods and Powers for maleficia, including the minimum pairings and how to adapt an existing Method.
quotes: each new Method must be associated with at least two Powers, and each new Power must use at least one Method

entries.title: Unholy Powers (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the six unholy Powers, each combined with an unholy Method to form an effect, with guidelines per combination.
quotes: There are six unholy Powers

entries.title: Consumption (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of drawing on the life and health of living beings: Debauchery reshapes the body, Incantation steals life from others, and failure deforms the caster.

entries.title: Diablerie (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of influencing demons and other supernatural beings within range, and how Forsaken Duration effects become Infernal blessings treated as Vengeful Powers.
quotes: Diablerie maleficia that grant Powers to the target are usually Forsaken Duration

entries.title: Effusion (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power over base materials and insubstantial forces: Debauchery governs fire, air and unseen forces, Incantation governs water, earth and cold matter. It cannot create anything living or make something from nothing.
quotes: Effusion cannot produce anything living

entries.title: Malediction (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of cursing: Incantation lays general curses, Debauchery lays destructive ones, with Infernal curses usually Forsaken in Duration, bad-luck side effects for roll penalties, and backfire on failure.
quotes: usually have a Forsaken Duration, so that they remain active until the victim can somehow dispel them

entries.title: Phantasm (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power of Infernal illusions that seem real: Debauchery conjures or transforms into phantasms, Incantation perceives and predicts. Phantasms are dispelled by the Divine, cannot survive in the Dominion, and are vulnerable to a chosen material.
quotes: Phantasms cannot survive in the Dominion.
If a phantasm is somehow affected by the Divine, it is immediately dispelled

entries.title: Psychomachia (Unholy Power)
entries.summary: Describes the Power over mind and emotion: Incantation reads and controls minds, Debauchery changes personality so the target wants to sin, and failure muddles the caster.
quotes: with Debauchery the caster can change the target's personality

entries.title: Ars Notoria (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the Notory Art of King Solomon, a Christian system of orations and figures (notae) combined into rings that grant divinely given knowledge and abilities; only Gifted Christians can use it.

entries.title: Finding a Text of the Ars Notoria
entries.summary: A character can seek a copy of the Ars Notoria through a story or, less entertainingly, spend a season rolling Intelligence + Divine Lore against a high Ease Factor; a botch turns up some other book.
quotes: FINDING A COPY OF ARS NOTORIA: Intelligence + Divine Lore + stress die vs. an Ease Factor of 21

entries.title: Studying the Ars Notoria
entries.summary: Learning the Ability from the text requires reading four languages and Artes Liberales, a Gifted reader and the normal rules for learning a Supernatural Ability; starting characters must take it as a Major Supernatural Virtue.
quotes: The reader needs a 4 in each Language to accurately read the book.
The Ars Notoria text is treated as a tractatus with a Quality of 20.

entries.title: Ars Notoria: Future Study
entries.summary: Ars Notoria is increased by study like other Abilities; glosses help with understanding but cannot teach the Ability initially.

entries.title: The Rings of Solomon (recitation rules)
entries.summary: Explains how rings are recited: a recitation score plus a stress die against an Ease Factor depending on ring level and duration, season-long first recitations, learning rings in order, no stacking of benefits, and tracking temporary experience.
quotes: RECITATION SCORE: Intelligence + Ars Notoria + Modifier
FIRST RECITATION OF AN ARS NOTORIA RING: Ease Factor = 6 + 3 times level of ring + 1 per season of desired duration
SUBSEQUENT RECITATIONS OF A KNOWN ARS NOTORIA RING: Ease Factor = 3 + 3 times level of ring + 1 per season of desired duration

entries.title: Ars Notoria Modifiers
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to the recitation score for behavior such as fasting, chastity, personality Flaws, sins and conflicting Supernatural Abilities, with explanations including the fasting roll.
quotes: Characters wishing to fast for a season must make a Stamina + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of 6 to succeed.
| Performing a Mortal Sin| –9 |

entries.title: First Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: First ring, recited in spring or autumn, grants temporary experience in Philosophiae and raises Communication.
quotes: Successfully reciting this oration gives you 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Philosophiae.

entries.title: Second Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Second ring, recited in winter, grants temporary experience in Theology and raises Intelligence.
quotes: With a successful recitation of the second ring, you gain 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Theology.

entries.title: Third Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Third ring, recitable in any season, grants temporary experience in Medicine and the Greater Purifying Touch Virtue for a chosen disease.
quotes: A person gains 100 experience points in the Academic Ability: Medicine, and also receives for free the Supernatural Major Virtue: Greater Purifying Touch.

entries.title: Fourth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Fourth ring summons a personal patron angel who acts as a guardian and teacher of academic Abilities, and may end the ring or cancel other rings if the character acts impiously.
quotes: Successfully reciting the fourth ring grants you the Major General Virtue: Patron Angel.

entries.title: Fifth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Fifth ring, recited in summer, lets the character determine which realm a being is affiliated with and possibly learn its powers, with no need to Penetrate.
quotes: SENSE REALM AFFILIATION: Perception + Ars Notoria vs. 6 + Target's Magic Resistance/5

entries.title: Sixth Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Sixth ring, recited in spring, provides holy divination about the results of actions via a Perception + Ars Notoria roll against difficulties listed in a table.
quotes: DIVINATION: Perception + Ars Notoria vs. variable Ease Factor

entries.title: Seventh Ring of Solomon
entries.summary: Seventh ring gives perfect understanding of known skills: simple die rolls become stress dice and stress dice cannot botch, though the patron angel may end it for Pride.
quotes: In game terms, you replace all your simple die rolls with stress die rolls.

entries.title: Ars Notoria: Beneficial Side-Effects
entries.summary: Ars Notoria score reduces the Divine-aura penalty to other magic and an active ring prevents Warping Points from Divine auras.
quotes: For each point of Ars Notoria you have, you may reduce the Divine penalty received from the Realm Interaction Chart by 3.

entries.title: Folk Witch Magic
entries.summary: Folk witches use seven favored Supernatural Abilities, advanced on the standard Ability table, accessed by potions, incantations or fetish objects, with limited Magical Defenses but no Magic Resistance.
quotes: folk witches use the standard Ability experience advancement table when improving these Abilities

entries.title: Folk Witch Powers (casting formulas)
entries.summary: A folk witch's Casting Score is a Characteristic plus Ability plus aura, plus a stress die for the Total, compared to the effect's Ease Factor; Gifted witches can add vis, and Penetration follows from the Total.
quotes: FOLK WITCH CASTING SCORE: Characteristic + Ability + Aura Modifier
MAGNITUDE OF EFFECT: Ability
EQUIVALENT SPELL LEVEL: (5 x Ability)
PENETRATION TOTAL: Casting Total + Penetration Bonus — Ease Factor
MAXIMUM VIS EXPENDITURE: Ability + Effect Vis Cost

entries.title: Folk Witch Casting Methods
entries.summary: Each Ability must be used by Potion, Incantation (a rhyme the target hears) or Fetish (a prepared item), with rules for losing the incantation from memory and for spare fetishes.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 6 for her every day after the memory-altering effect ceases

entries.title: Folk Witch Botches
entries.summary: A botch makes the effect happen uncontrolled and gives the witch Warping Points.
quotes: She also gains 1 Warping Point for every 0 on the botch dice

entries.title: Folk Witch Mark
entries.summary: Each witch's effects carry a personal mark that others can recognize with a Perception and Organization Lore roll; identifying merely that a witch cast it is easier.
quotes: make a Perception + Organization Lore: Folk Witch roll against an Ease Factor of 9
a successful Perception + Organization Lore: Folk Witch roll against an Ease Factor of 6 identifies an effect as one cast by a Folk Witch

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Animal Ken
entries.summary: Folk witch Animal Ken uses Communication and the Animal Form, delivered by incantation or potion.
quotes: Characteristic: Communication

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Cursing (and the curses)
entries.summary: A witch curses a target via a woven fetish or potion, using Dexterity and a Form that depends on the curse; each curse type (disease, miscarriage, aging, emotion, tongue, paralysis, beast, reduction) has its own Ease Factor and effect, and the curse must penetrate the target's Magic Resistance throughout the preparation season.
quotes: Preparing the curse is a laboratory activity that takes the folk witch an entire season
use the highest Magic Resistance the target has during the season

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Dowsing
entries.summary: Folk witch Dowsing uses Perception, a Form that depends on the target, and a fetish or potion; it lets witches find vis.
quotes: This ability is important for folk witches as it allows them to find vis.

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Flight
entries.summary: A witch can fly using Stamina and Auram, at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level when using a fetish; it describes speed, duration, maneuver rolls and a combat bonus against non-flying opponents.
quotes: The Ease Factor to take to the air is 9.
her Flight Ability score is added to both her Attack and Defense Totals

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Healing
entries.summary: True healing of wounds and Fatigue that breaks the Limit of Energy; it costs Corpus vis according to a table of Ease Factors by wound or fatigue level, and must penetrate the target's Magic Resistance.
quotes: the folk witch must spend a number of pawns of Corpus vis depending on the wound type (indicated below)

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Second Sight
entries.summary: Folk witch Second Sight uses Perception and the Vim Form, delivered by incantation or potion.
quotes: Form: Vim

entries.title: Folk Witch Ability: Shapeshifter
entries.summary: Folk witch Shapeshifter uses Stamina and the Animal Form, delivered by fetish (made from the animal's skin) or potion.
quotes: The fetish is made from the skin of the animal form.

entries.title: Sabbat
entries.summary: The coven meeting where witches trade vis and discuss threats; because witches lack Parma Magica the Gift's social effects often cause bickering, and a sabbat does not interrupt long-term tasks.

entries.title: Infernal Traditions: learning Infernal Abilities and Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Touched by evil (Warping Point from an Infernal source, a deal with a demon, or any Infernal Virtue or Flaw)
entries.summary: Defines Infernal traditions for game purposes, who can learn Infernal Supernatural Abilities and how the study activity works, and the four Favored Abilities each tradition specializes in (one tradition per lifetime).
quotes: you must subtract the character's scores in other Supernatural Abilities from the total experience gained in a season of study, and you must reach a score of 1 in that season to learn the Ability.
Infernal traditions usually have four Supernatural Abilities in which they specialize

entries.title: Luciferans (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists deceived into following a seemingly holy Lucifer; lists their Favored Abilities and notes that a character can play one who thinks he is pious, with Powers relabeled as Divine counterparts.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Debauchery, Diablerie, Malediction, Sense Passions

entries.title: Unknowing Evil (playing an unwitting Luciferan)
entries.summary: Optional rule letting the storyguide disguise a Luciferan character's Powers under Divine-sounding names so the player can portray an infernalist who believes he is holy.
quotes: labeling Debauchery, Diablerie, and Malediction as Purity, Adjuration, and Cursing

entries.title: Strigae (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Night-witch covens led by a senior infernalist with a demonic patron; lists the Favored Abilities and describes how covens operate, including the Benandanti nightwalkers who fight the stregoni.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Debauchery, Effusion, Phantasm, Ceremony

entries.title: Witch-Hammers (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists who hunt witches and heretics, taught by the malleus epistula, which acts as a summa on the tradition's four Favored Abilities.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ablating, Incantation, Psychomachia, Summoning
is essentially a summa (Quality 26, Level 1) on all four Favored Abilities of the tradition

entries.title: Dark Gnostics (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalist heretics who teach that sinful acts have moral value; the entry lists their Favored Abilities and describes their beliefs and use of maleficia to gain insight.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Diablerie, Entrancement, Incantation, Phantasm

entries.title: The Dread Host (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Infernalists who bind demons and spirits into servants, relics and possessed followers, hoping to become Infernal ghosts after death; lists the Favored Abilities and describes the possession-driven danse macabre.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Binding, Effusion, Incantation, Summoning

entries.title: The Mulhidun (Infernal tradition)
entries.summary: Eastern demonologists who summon and enslave demons to labor for them; lists the Favored Abilities and describes how binding demons to charms lets outsiders think all of them can command demons.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ablating, Binding, Commanding, Summoning

entries.title: The Damhadh-Duidsan (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Damhadh-Duidsan (House Ex Miscellanea lineage)
entries.summary: Hermetic lineage descended from a Gaelic hedge wizard that uses rune-based curses; gives the Favored Abilities and a template for designing a member, with Giant Blood common.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Incantation, Malediction, Shapechanging
use the Ex Miscellanea character template, taking Puissant Corpus, Necessary Condition (runes), and either Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation for your free Virtues and Flaws

entries.title: Ogam Writing
entries.summary: Explains the Gaelic runic writing used by the Damhadh-Duidsan to inscribe incantations and the modest Language requirement it carries.
quotes: a Language score of at least 2 that may be used to sound out the letters

entries.title: The Ordo Vagorum (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Ordo Vagorum (Goliards; Clerk or Educated, sinful Compulsion)
entries.summary: Wandering student-clergy infernalists (Goliards) loosely tied to House Mercere; lists Favored Abilities and the requirements for joining, such as Clerk or Educated plus a sinful Compulsion and an Infernal background Virtue or Flaw.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Consumption, Corruption, Debauchery, Psychomachia
they should take either Clerk or Educated, and have some sort of sinful Compulsion

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, p.93 Goliards

entries.title: The Witches of Thessaly (Infernal societas)
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea or other witches; Chthonic Magic)
entries.summary: Chthonic witches of Thessaly and their Hermetic sisters; lists Favored Abilities, notes that kin in the tradition learn Supernatural Abilities without penalty, and gives free Virtue and Flaw suggestions for Ex Miscellanea Thessalians.
quotes: Favored Abilties: Chthonic Magic, Commanding, Hex, Summoning
for as members of the same Infernal tradition they can learn their Supernatural Abilities without penalty

entries.title: Drawing Down the Moon
entries.requires: Infernal Societas: The Witches of Thessaly
entries.summary: The Thessalian rite of summoning the succubus Selene to seduce a man, which yields virus lunare that serves as an Arcane Connection, and can be made fixed by working it into a kolossos figurine.
quotes: This liquid is treated as an Arcane Connection to the man she seduced, and lasts for one month.

entries.title: Straying (Ekstasis) Overview
entries.summary: Introduces ekstasis or straying, the power that lets a nightwalker send his spirit out of his sleeping body. It arises untrained and has no Ability that improves with practice.
quotes: It is a power that arises without training, and has no corresponding Ability

entries.title: Preparation for Straying
entries.summary: How a nightwalker induces insensibility so the spirit can stray: sleep, illness, asceticism, Hermetic sleep spells or drugs. Drugs take a time that depends on Concentration, and a poisoned victim may resist with a Stamina roll.
quotes: a character using drugs takes (10 – Concentration) minutes to reach insensibility, with a minimum time of one minute
Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: The Insensate Body and Straying Fatigue
entries.summary: Describes the helpless, death-like body left behind during straying, the danger of it being disturbed, and the Long Term Fatigue cost of straying for an hour or a whole night.
quotes: they have lost a Long Term Fatigue level
they have lost 2 Long Term Fatigue levels

entries.title: The Phantasticum
entries.summary: Rules for the straying spirit form: it can be corporeal or immaterial, visible or invisible, human or animal, and switching state takes rounds and a roll if attempted in combat.
quotes: Switching between corporeality and immateriality takes three rounds, and cannot be performed during combat without a Stamina + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 15.

entries.title: Second Sight and Magical Air in Spirit Form
entries.summary: A nightwalker in spirit form may use Second Sight, and the phantasticum unsettles humans and is sensed by domestic animals.
quotes: While in spirit form, the nightwalker may use the Second Sight Ability.

entries.title: Travel Through Straying
entries.summary: Spirit travel is almost instant and uses a Stamina + Athletics roll whose result sets how familiar a destination must be. Extra carried objects raise the difficulty and some journeys succeed automatically.
quotes: needs to make a Stamina + Athletics roll
increases the difficulty of the roll by +3 per object

entries.title: Combat Statistics for Animal Phantastica
entries.summary: A system for building the animal-shaped phantasticum: combine the species statistics with the character's Characteristics, apply Size and body Virtues and Flaws, and use the animal's General Abilities.
quotes: if both the species and character have a negative score, use the lowest score. If both the species and the character have a positive score, use the highest.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic, Book of Mundane Beasts

entries.title: Communications Through Straying
entries.summary: A corporeal phantasticum can talk with people at its destination at the cost of extra fatigue, while speaking to sleepers is remembered as dreams unless an Intelligence + Concentration roll preserves details.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration roll against an Ease Factor of 12

entries.title: Leading Others Astray
entries.summary: A nightwalker can guide willing people out of their bodies with a Stamina + Leadership roll, and failed guidance leaves the lost spirits to find their way back.
quotes: Stamina + Leadership roll against an Ease Factor 3 points higher than that for personal travel
requires a Stamina + Leadership roll against an Ease Factor of 3

entries.title: Combat and the Straying Spirit
entries.summary: Corporeal phantastica fight material foes and immaterial ones fight only spirits; damage to the phantasticum is mirrored on the sleeping body, scaled up or down for animal forms.
quotes: Any damage a phantasticum in human form suffers appears, instantly and identically, on the body of the nightwalker.

entries.title: Drowsiness
entries.summary: A hostile phantasticum makes bystanders drowsy; a waking character without Magic Resistance must roll to stay awake and a sleeper is nearly impossible to wake.
quotes: Concentration + Stamina roll against an Ease Factor of 3

entries.title: Returning Home and Spiritual Nourishment
entries.summary: After battle nightwalkers drift home invisibly and take spiritual nourishment, whose form varies by tradition, to shorten their Long Term Fatigue.
quotes: Returning nightwalkers often take spiritual nourishment so that they suffer Long Term Fatigue for a briefer time.

entries.title: Statistics and Abilities for Flame Shape
entries.summary: Rules for a taltos in the form of a ball or wheel of flame, built from the characteristics of an elemental: fixed Characteristics, Abilities that can be used, fire Damage, fire vulnerability immunities and a Hungry Personality trait.
quotes: suffer +5 burn damage for each attack (Penetration 0)
and does +5 fire Damage

entries.title: Learning Methods and Powers
entries.requires: True Faith or an appropriate Virtue
entries.summary: Explains how holy Methods and Powers are learned as Supernatural Abilities within a tradition, with favored Abilities that avoid the usual study penalty.
quotes: they do not have to subtract the total of their Supernatural Ability scores from their Advancement Total

entries.title: Creating New Traditions
entries.summary: Guidance for designing a new holy tradition, including how to add Methods or Powers and a limit on favored Abilities.
quotes: you should assign your new tradition a maximum of four favored Abilities

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Ascetics
entries.summary: A sample generic holy tradition of ascetics, with its favored Abilities and ethos.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Adjuration, Cursing, Purity, Second Sight

entries.title: Holy Tradition: The Cantores
entries.summary: Christian holy tradition of musician-worshippers with Blessing, Enchanting Music, Holy Music and Intervention as favored Abilities.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Blessing, Enchanting Music, Holy Music, Intervention

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Sufis
entries.summary: Describes the Sufi holy tradition, its favored Abilities and its group dhikr and sama' meditation rituals, whose benefits are boosted by a shaykh's Ceremony Ability.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Ceremony, Meditation, Transcendence, Understanding
their shaykhs will often possess the Ceremony Ability, which enables them to synchronize their efforts in order to reach higher degrees of understanding.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, Blessed by God, New Abilities (Ceremony)

entries.title: Holy Societas: Zoroastrians
entries.summary: Describes the Zoroastrian holy societas of Magoi, including favored Abilities, taboos of purity, and its link to Holy Magic and Hermetic House Flambeau.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Invocation, Holy Magic, Sense Holiness and Unholiness, Wonders
These spells require Holy Magic to cast and are only taught to members of the tradition.

entries.title: (Immortal)'s Blessing (Zoroastrian Ritual)
entries.requires: Tradition: Holy Societas Zoroastrians; Holy Magic
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic holy ritual giving a bonus to the next spell cast, with seven versions tied to an Immortal, a Personality trait and a Form; the bonus is capped by the caster's trait.
quotes: Your score in this Personality trait (or a closely related trait), multiplied by ten, determines the maximum bonus granted by this ritual.

entries.title: Saoshyant's Elixir (Zoroastrian Ritual)
entries.requires: Tradition: Holy Societas Zoroastrians; Holy Magic
entries.summary: A non-Hermetic holy ritual of eternal life: after an ordeal and sacrifice the caster stops aging rolls and cannot die while strictly following Zoroastrianism, at the cost of accumulating Warping points.
quotes: Drink this, and for as long as you strictly follow Zoroastrianism, you do not have to make aging rolls and cannot die.

related.text: ArM5 p.181 Injuries, Heat and Corrosion

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Ba'al Shem
entries.summary: The tradition of itinerant Jewish folk magicians who make amulets and give blessings, with its favored Abilities and note that Initiations grant extra Methods and Powers.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Adjuration, Blessing, Craft Amulets, and Invocation

entries.title: Holy Societates: Karaites
entries.summary: Describes Karaite Gifted magi who may join the Order if their magic is Holy Magic; lists required Flaws and favored Abilities, and the restriction on taking apprentices.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Craft Amulets, Holy Magic, Merkavah, Transcendence
Hermetic Karaites can only take Gifted apprentices from within their own religion.

entries.title: Faerie Powers
entries.requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Explains that Faerie Powers are Supernatural Abilities used only with a Faerie Method, and that each Power has a vulnerability chosen when it is gained.
quotes: Every Faerie Power is vulnerable to certain uncommon circumstances, such as when touching iron, running water, or salt, when in the Dominion, or when repeating the character's name three times.

entries.title: Beguile (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for commanding targets or altering their memories, perceptions and emotions; any Sympathy Trait appropriate to the memory, emotion or perception can apply.

entries.title: Conjure (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power creating solid glamours or transforming a target into something else; the caster needs Sympathy Traits for both the original and new forms, and glamours can defy ordinary space and end unpredictably.

entries.title: Dream (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for perceiving things from outside one's body and glimpsing the future; includes advice for storyguides on handling prophetic visions as vague good or bad omens tied to a symbol.

entries.title: Grant (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for blessing or cursing a target with Warping Points, temporary Virtues and Flaws, or temporary Sympathy Traits that cannot be increased and do not affect Faerie Rank.

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Charms and Sympathetic Influence

entries.title: Portage (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for instant travel by faerie trods, moving the target and what is attached to it from one place to another.

entries.title: Ware (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for protecting a target with wards against chosen things; wards often need a second Sympathy Trait describing what is warded against, both used for the maximum level, and must penetrate Magic Resistance.
quotes: Use both of these Traits to determine the maximum level of the effect.

entries.title: Weal (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power that alters natural healing and aging for the duration, speeding recovery or slowing aging; cannot return a character to childhood.
quotes: This effect cannot cause a character to revert to childhood, nor can it affect a character who has not yet reached physical maturity.

entries.title: Woe (Faerie Power)
entries.summary: Faerie Power for inflicting wounds, Fatigue loss, aging and slowed healing that vanish when the effect ends.

entries.title: Hedge Magic: common rules
entries.summary: Introduces the common rules shared by hedge traditions and advises troupes designing their own traditions to break only a few of them.

entries.title: The Gift in hedge traditions
entries.summary: Notes that some hedge traditions are exclusively Gifted and others include unGifted members, and what that implies about their size, isolation and survival.

entries.title: The Limits of Magic and hedge magic
entries.summary: Hedge magic is bound by the Limits of Magic; troupe-designed traditions should break at most one Lesser Limit and no Greater Limit, and should respect the new Limit of Magic Resistance.
quotes: traditions devised by the troupe break no more than one of the Lesser Limits of Magic

entries.title: Hedge Arts and Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: Hedge traditions produce effects through combinations of hedge Arts, through Supernatural Abilities, or both; hedge Arts do not combine with Hermetic Arts or with other traditions' Arts.

entries.title: Difficult Arts Mechanically (design guideline)
entries.summary: Design advice: if a combination of hedge Arts can affect magi, at least one of them should be a Difficult Art so hedge wizards cannot easily get high Penetration.

entries.title: Difficult Arts
entries.summary: Difficult Arts are bought and advanced like Abilities rather than Arts, but otherwise act as Arts for vis study, Magical Foci and Virtues that affect Arts.
quotes: it costs 5 experience points for a score of 1, 15 experience points for a score of 2, etc

entries.title: Accelerated Abilities
entries.summary: The counterpart to Difficult Arts: Abilities that advance like Arts at one experience point for a score of 1, are not capped at creation, and are otherwise treated as Abilities.
quotes: costing one experience point for a score of 1

entries.title: Favored Abilities
entries.requires: Gifted member of a tradition with favored Supernatural Abilities
entries.summary: Gifted characters of some traditions need not subtract their favored Supernatural Ability scores from the source quality when learning other favored Abilities, but do subtract all of them when learning non-favored ones.

entries.title: The Limit of Magic Resistance
entries.summary: A proposed new Limit of Magic: no hedge tradition has a general resistance to magic, and the Order ruthlessly eliminates any that develop one.
quotes: No hedge tradition has a general resistance to magic.

entries.title: Secrets of the Necromancer
entries.summary: Introduces Canaanite necromancy as a Major Supernatural Virtue and matching Supernatural Ability, noting that learning it from the ghost of Zephaniah is impractical for magi and that integration into Hermetic theory is the realistic route.

entries.title: Major Supernatural Virtue: Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: A Canaanite necromancer replicates Hermetic Corpus or Mentem effects dealing with communicating with, commanding or summoning the dead using a stress roll against an Ease Factor scaled to the effect's magnitude, and can use the Veil of Death range.
quotes: A stress roll of Communication + Canaanite Necromancy Ability against an Ease Factor of (3 x the magnitude of the effect)
Communication + Canaanite Necromancy Ability + stress die vs. Ease Factor (3 x magnitude of effect)

entries.title: Hermetic Integration (Canaanite Necromancy)
entries.summary: A magus working with a Canaanite necromancer assistant gains Insight Lab Texts and invents effects dealing with the dead, accumulating breakthrough points until the Minor Hermetic Virtue Canaanite Magic is gained.
quotes: To Integrate Canaanite Necromancy: Accumulate 45 or more breakthrough points

entries.title: Minor Hermetic Virtue: Canaanite Magic
entries.summary: The integrated Virtue grants the Veil of Death range, a permanent Arcane Connection to all the dead with a Penetration bonus, and in return the dead always sense the magus and hold an Arcane Connection to him.
quotes: exploit this Arcane Connection for a +4 Penetration multiplier bonus
a simple Perception roll against an Ease Factor of 6

entries.title: Who is Dead?
entries.requires: Virtue: Canaanite Magic or Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: Defines which dead can be reached by Canaanite necromancy (mortals not yet in Heaven, ghosts) and which cannot (animals, faeries, Final Twilight), and doubles botch dice when targeting those given a Divine burial rite.
quotes: if the caster botches double the number of botch dice are rolled

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine (extreme unction)

entries.title: Speaking to the Dead
entries.requires: Virtue: Canaanite Magic or Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: Advice on the limits of conversing with the long dead: mutual incomprehension, little reason to cooperate, and no information about the afterlife beyond who is in the world of the dead.

entries.title: The Infernal and Necromancy
entries.summary: A botched attempt to summon or speak to the dead usually draws a malevolent spirit that impersonates the target and subtly corrupts what it says; Hermetic magic cannot see through the deception.
quotes: If a character botches when attempting to summon or speak to the dead, a likely result is that a malevolent spirit pretends to be the intended target.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal (Infernal ghosts)

entries.title: Finding En-Dor
entries.summary: Locating the true site of En-Dor takes a season of searching and a roll that is harder if the searcher is not in the field; teams use the leader's scores with a bonus for similarly skilled helpers, and rival groups are resolved by the higher total.
quotes: To Find En-Dor: Int + Area Lore Canaan + stress die vs. Ease Factor 18 (or 21 if not in the field)
To search among the various possible locations to find the true location of En-Dor takes one season.

entries.title: Ex Miscellanea Traditions
entries.summary: Introduces three simple Ex Miscellanea magical traditions that can be chosen for a maga, noting others are in Houses of Hermes: Societates.
quotes: House Ex Miscellanea is not at all unified, consisting of many different magical traditions.

entries.title: Beast Masters
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A tradition of summoning and controlling wild creatures; members get Animal Ken and a Minor Magical Focus with a group of animals, the Incompatible Arts Flaw, and a Virtue and Flaw balance of their own.
quotes: They must take at least one more Flaw to balance their Virtues, and then have only 8 points of Flaws available to them to buy another 8 points of Virtues.

entries.title: Summon Animals
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to summon mundane animals by an audible call; the Ability score sets the number and size of animals arriving, and a Communication + Summon Animals roll sets arrival time.
quotes: He must then make a Communication + Summon Animals roll against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: The Nemthengacha
entries.summary: Background of the Nemthengacha, an Ex Miscellanea tradition of Celtic and Scandinavian sorcerers who create animosity and dissent in listeners.
quotes: The Nemthengacha (singular: Nemthenga) are a sect of Ex Miscellanea magi who have the ability to create animosity and dissent in their listeners.

entries.title: Nemthengacha Powers
entries.summary: A Nemthenga receives Embitterment as a free Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Deficient Technique Rego as a compulsory Major Flaw, and Subtle Magic as a free Minor Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Each has the Major Hermetic Flaw: Deficient Technique Rego.

entries.title: Embitterment
entries.summary: A Major Supernatural Ability that turns a listener against a chosen target by conversation, with an Ease Factor by relationship and increases for hatred, loathing and longer duration; it can be cancelled by Vim, Mentem effects.
quotes: EMBITTERMENT ROLL: Communication + Embitterment + Stress Die
Increasing this animosity to hatred adds +3 to the Ease Factor.
consider the effective level of the embitterment to be equal to the Nemthenga's score in Embitterment times five

entries.title: Tempestaria (Weather Witch)
entries.summary: A Saxon weather-witch tradition using simple sympathetic tools, with Whistle Up The Wind as its Major Non-Hermetic Virtue, Affinity with Auram, and a Necessary Condition Flaw.
quotes: Major Hermetic Flaw: Necessary Condition (tools for their magic to work)

entries.title: Whistle Up The Wind
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to create a wind of a chosen strength by whistling, with an Ease Factor table by strength, changeable with Communication + Music rolls, diminishing each sunset.
quotes: makes a Stamina + Whistle Up The Wind roll, against the Ease Factor listed in the table below

entries.title: Magic Defenses (hedge wizards)
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that grants Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Hedge wizards have no true Magic Resistance but may gain limited Magical Defense Bonuses in their area of specialty, derived from a hedge Art or Supernatural Ability; defenses do not stack, cannot be switched off and do not apply to Personal Range effects.
quotes: Magical Defense Bonus: Art divided by 5 (round up) or Ability Score
Magical defenses are not cumulative.
Magical defenses do not apply to effects that have a Personal Range.

related.text: Hedge Magic: Greater Magical Defenses and No Magical Defenses

entries.title: Magical Defense: Accelerated Expiry
entries.summary: Spells cast on the hedge wizard within his specialty expire early by an amount that depends on the spell's Duration category.
quotes: Diameter Duration spells expire a number of rounds too early equal to the hedge wizard's Magical Defense Bonus, but last at least one round.

entries.title: Magical Defense: Alacritous Fortune
entries.summary: The hedge wizard adds his Magical Defense Bonus to his Defense Total against spells aimed at him.
quotes: The hedge wizard adds his Magical Defense Bonus to his Defense Total when spells are aimed at him.

entries.title: Magical Defense: Confounding Magics
entries.summary: Makes Concentration rolls harder for casters of Concentration-duration effects aimed at the hedge wizard; in a Group effect only the best bonus among such hedge wizards applies.
quotes: Add the hedge wizards Magical Defense Bonus to the Ease Factor of Concentration rolls

entries.title: Magical Defense: Immovable Object
entries.summary: Each round the hedge wizard rolls to shake off a controlling effect in his specialty, with his Strength and Magical Defense Bonus offsetting the effect's magnitude.
quotes: Strength + Magical Defense Bonus

entries.title: Magical Defense: Magical Fortitude
entries.summary: Damaging effects in the hedge wizard's specialty are soaked with an added Magical Defense Bonus.
quotes: he receives a Magical Defense Bonus to his Soak Total

entries.title: Magical Defense: Strength of Form
entries.requires: Hedge tradition granting Strength of Form
entries.summary: When a form-changing effect in his specialty affects him, the hedge wizard may roll to return to his natural form.
quotes: Stamina + Magical Defense Bonus + simple die roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Folk Witch Magical Defenses
entries.summary: Lists which Magical Defense each folk witch power grants (for example Healing gives Magical Fortitude against Corpus effects); an unGifted witch only gets defenses for powers she has.
quotes: Defense: Strength of Form. Defense against Animal or Corpus effects.

entries.title: Holy Magic (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces holy magic, a form of Hermetic-derived magic aligned wholly with God, which requires a magus to relearn much of their craft.

entries.title: Holy Magic Summary
entries.summary: Quick summary list of the restrictions and benefits of practicing holy magic.

entries.title: Holy Magic: Restrictions
entries.summary: Holy magi must relearn spells via the Holy Magic Ability, halve lab totals from Hermetic sources, forgo Hermetic words and gestures (offset by prayer), cannot use magic to sin, and draw Infernal and Faerie attention.
quotes: This is usually a –15 penalty
This requires that they roll a simple die + Presence + Theology of 15+
their lab totals must always be halved when learning magic from a Hermetic source

entries.title: Holy Magic: Benefits
entries.summary: Holy magi are attuned to Divine and Magic auras, may cast spells using miracle guidelines, substitute long-term fatigue for vis in rituals, do lab work in the Dominion, and use new Ranges, Durations and Targets.
quotes: Each Fatigue level spent during a ritual is equivalent to as many as three pawns of vis of an appropriate Art

entries.title: Holy Ranges, Durations, and Targets
entries.summary: New spell Range, Duration and Target categories for holy magic (such as Presence, Communion, Recitation, Office, Sabbath, Grace, Sin, Faith, Dominion), each equated to an existing Hermetic parameter for spell level.
quotes: For the purposes of calculating spell levels, this range is the same as Voice.
Dominion (Target): This is the same level as Boundary

entries.title: Holy Societates
entries.summary: Holy Societates are traditions that teach Holy Magic as a favored Ability and can train both Gifted and unGifted characters.

entries.title: Holy Societas: Sol Invictus
entries.summary: Sample holy societas listing favored Abilities, history and beliefs of the Invicti, a Hermetic society practicing holy magic.

entries.title: Holy Societas: The Priory of Saint Nerius
entries.requires: Holy Societas: Priory of Saint Nerius
entries.summary: A secret monastic Hermetic holy societas with Holy Magic, Intervention, Premonitions and Purity as favored Abilities; all members take the Monastic Vows (Hermetic) Flaw.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Holy Magic, Intervention, Premonitions, Purity
All Nerusians take the Monastic Vows (Hermetic) Flaw.

entries.title: Beast Masters (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Beast Masters tradition
entries.summary: Overview of a tradition that summons and controls wild creatures, giving its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and the required Virtues and Flaws that cut its free Flaw points.
quotes: They therefore have only 8 points of Flaws available to them to buy another 8 points of Virtues.
Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Summon Animals

entries.title: Damhadh-Duidsan (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Ogam rune tradition that curses enemies and steals their life, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Shapechanging, Giant Blood, or Incantation

entries.title: Hermetic Haruspexes (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Hermetic Haruspexes tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the Roman tradition of divination by inspecting the entrails of sacrificed animals, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and its susceptibility to Twilight.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Divination and Augury

entries.title: Karaites (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Karaite Jewish tradition of holy magic, which may join the Order only if it practises holy magic, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Holy Magic

entries.title: Malocchi (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the Italian tradition of Entrancement through the gaze, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a required extra Virtue.
quotes: As well as his free Virtues and Flaws, a maloccho must also take Piercing Gaze as a compulsory Virtue.

entries.title: Scinnfolk (Gifted Companions Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk tradition of Gifted Companions who keep natural and faerie charms instead of Hermetic magic, with its Virtue and common Virtue and Flaw choices.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Fertility (free with The Gift)

entries.title: Tempestaria (Weather Witch Tradition)
entries.summary: Overview of the weather-witch tradition whose magic exceeds Hermetic Auram and needs improvised sympathetic tools, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Whistle Up the Wind (or similar Ability)

entries.title: Witches of Thessaly (Ex Miscellanea Tradition)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea; Witches of Thessaly tradition
