entries.summary: Overview of the Thessalian tradition of sorcery, necromancy and curses, with its compulsory Virtue and Flaw package and a note on its suspicion of diabolism.
quotes: Major Non-Hermetic Virtue: Summoning

entries.title: The Goetic Arts
entries.summary: Overview of the four Goetic Arts (Summoning, Ablating, Binding, Commanding), which are learned like Supernatural Abilities but start at 0 and advance as Arts, with Penetration and optional sacrifice.
quotes: they are opened at 0 instead of 1

entries.title: Summoning
entries.summary: How a sorcerer draws a spirit into a circle: Summoning Total against double the spirit's Might, Hierarchy adjustments for demons, scouring for a non-specific spirit, time and Fatigue costs, concentration if the margin is thin, and botches.
quotes: Summoning Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Modifier)
Scouring Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + (Area) Lore + aura + Penetration
Summoning or Scouring Target Level: spirit's Might x 2

entries.title: Summoning and Other Realms
entries.summary: Explains that Summoning may belong to the Magic or Faerie realm for aura interaction yet always reads as unholy to Divine investigation.
quotes: Summoning is always tainted

entries.title: Ablating
entries.summary: Rules for stripping Might from a summoned spirit: an Ablation Total against the spirit's Might, permanent loss of Might for the spirit, and Ablation Points spent on Confidence, Characteristics, health, longevity, Might, Powers, vis and more.
quotes: Ablation Total: stress die + Stamina + Ablating + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Multiplier)
Ablation Points: (Ablation Total – Ablation Target Level) / 5, or spirit's Might / 5

entries.title: Binding
entries.summary: Rules for forcing a spirit into a person or object: a Binding Total against the spirit's Might, Magic Resistance from the bound spirit, anchoring maleficia in objects, learning the spirit's Abilities and Powers, and Warping and aging effects.
quotes: Binding Total: stress die + Intelligence + Binding + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Multiplier)
The binding can hold a number of spell levels equal to the spirit's (Might x 5)

entries.title: Commanding
entries.summary: Rules for ordering a summoned spirit: a Commanding Total against its Might, commands lasting until midday or midnight, and a list of common commands such as Follow me, Aid me, Protect me and Teach me.
quotes: Commanding Total: stress die + Communication + Commanding + (Realm) Lore + aura + (Penetration x Penetration Modifier)
A command has force for only a short while, however, only until midday or midnight

entries.title: Faerie Bargaining (Ars Fabulosa)
entries.requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
entries.summary: Introduces the Ars Fabulosa, the hedge art of bargaining with faeries through four powers (Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing) that start at score 0, increase like Arts, and are learned as Supernatural Abilities or from Virtues.
quotes: There are four powers associated with bargaining: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, and Dismissing.

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Faerie Abilities

entries.title: Summoning (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Procedure for summoning a faerie: Sympathy Traits cap the Might that can be summoned, a Fatigue level is spent, a Summoning Total is rolled against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, and success holds the faerie to listen and bargain; covers botches, specific faeries, failure, and the experience and penalty for keeping or breaking a bargain.
quotes: Summoning Total: stress die + Presence + Summoning + Faerie Rank + aura Maximum Might
The sum of these Traits, multiplied by 5, determines the maximum Might Score that the character can summon.

entries.title: Bonding (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power forming a mystic bond with a faerie, using a Bonding Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance, which lets the bearer use the faerie's Characteristics, powers, a shared enchanted effect, or protections from Warping and hardship; bonds to objects need a charm and only one bond can be held at a time.
quotes: Bonding Total: stress die + Communication + Bonding + Faerie Rank + aura
Maximum Might Score: (Sympathy Traits x 5)

entries.title: Faerie Bargains
entries.requires: Faerie Bargaining: one of the Virtues Summoning, Bonding, Captivating or Dismissing
entries.summary: Guidance on conducting a bargaining session with a faerie: working out what it wants with Intelligence + Faerie Lore, roleplaying etiquette, a contested roll to resolve a stalled session, and typical offers and requests.
quotes: you can quickly resolve the bargaining session with a contested Communication + Bargain roll, modified by the character's Faerie Rank.

entries.title: Captivating (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power for exchanging places with a faerie, with a Captivating Total against the faerie's Might and Magic Resistance; covers what is exchanged, struggles for dominance, and the Warping Points gained.
quotes: Captivating Total: stress die + Perception + Captivating + Faerie Rank + aura

entries.title: Dismissing (Faerie Bargaining)
entries.summary: Power for cancelling effects made by beings with Might, ending effects on them, or releasing them from supernatural agreements, using a Dismissing Total limited by Sympathy Traits; can deflect powers and dismiss several effects with a cumulative penalty.
quotes: Dismissing Total: stress die + Intelligence + Dismissing + Faerie Rank + aura

entries.title: Fertility Battles
entries.summary: Every nightwalker answers summons to seasonal spirit battles whose outcome decides whether the local harvest, hunting and fishing are normal, poor or bountiful.
quotes: most do battle four times a year

entries.title: Giving Battle
entries.summary: How a night battle is run: either the player rolls for a disciplined militia or the character seeks individual foes in a mêlée, using Perception + Awareness to find enemies.
quotes: Perception + Awareness roll of 9 or more

entries.title: Covenants Supplement Modifiers (Fertility Battle Outcomes)
entries.summary: A table that maps the outcome of a fertility battle onto the Income Modification Table of the Covenants supplement in place of the stress die roll.
quotes: This selection replaces the stress die roll.

entries.title: Night Battle Enemies
entries.summary: Guidance for statting the foes in night battles: enemy nightwalkers like player characters or quick grogs, the dead from ghost statistics, and Infernal servants and demonic captains from the Infernal and Divine books.
quotes: Demonic captains are generally Aerial Powers with a Might score of 20 or less.

entries.title: Musters Out of Season and Recognising Fellow Nightwalkers
entries.summary: Special musters can be called to deal with a local evil, and nightwalkers recognise each other or Infernal witches in waking life with a Perception + Awareness roll reduced by Reputation and frequency of meeting.
quotes: Perception + Awareness roll of (15 - the highest applicable Reputation of the observed)

entries.title: Nightwalker Taboo on Waking Contests
entries.summary: Nightwalkers and Infernal witches may duel in waking life, but breaking the taboo against speaking about the night battles brings dream beatings whose injuries show on the waking body.
quotes: If either breaks their taboo they are terribly beaten, in their dreams

entries.title: Gruagach Training
entries.summary: Explains how gruagachan are taught and how they improve: through a master, vis, exposure or adventure, with Abilities (but not Arts) also raisable by practice.
quotes: gruagachan may not improve their Arts through practice

entries.title: Gruagach Abilities (Gruagach Lore and Pictish Language)
entries.summary: Describes Gruagach Lore and Pictish Language, the latter acting as the gruagach equivalent of Magic Theory and capping how high the gruagach's Arts may rise.
quotes: With a Pictish score of 1, a gruagach's Arts may not exceed a score of 5.

entries.title: Gruagach Arts
entries.summary: Introduces the gruagach Techniques and Forms; a caster needs both a Technique and a Form, and an unGifted gruagach needs the matching Virtue for each Art used.

entries.title: Gruagach Techniques (Give and Take)
entries.summary: Describes the Give and Take Techniques, which grant things to or remove things from a target, and how they relate to Hermetic Techniques.

entries.title: Gruagach Forms (Blessing, Curse, Shape, Vision)
entries.summary: Describes the four gruagach Forms and what each can do with Give and Take, including which Virtues Blessing cannot affect and the conditions attached to curses.

entries.title: Spirit Magic (gruagach sidebar)
entries.summary: States that gruagach magic cannot affect the dead or their spirits, and points to the Ars Goetica rules for characters who want to command spirits.
quotes: The magic of the gruagachan cannot affect the dead or their spirits.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.114 Ars Goetica

entries.title: Learned Magician Training
entries.summary: Learned magicians learn from a master then study from texts written under the normal text rules.

entries.title: Lore of the Mathematici
entries.summary: Describes the Organization Lore of the Mathematici of Bologna and what a character with it knows.

entries.title: Magic of the Learned Magicians (charms, amulets and chartae)
entries.summary: Overview of verbal charms, chartae and amulets, and how charm magic bypasses the Arcane Connection requirement but must still overcome Magic Resistance.

entries.title: Learned Magician Arts
entries.summary: Learned magicians have three Techniques and three Forms; every charm or amulet needs one of each, and unGifted characters need the matching Virtue for each Art.

entries.title: Learned Magician Techniques (Tueor, Succurro, Vulnero)
entries.summary: Describes the Tueor, Succurro and Vulnero Techniques, what each can and cannot do, and how they relate to Hermetic Rego, Creo and Perdo.

entries.title: Learned Magician Forms (Fortunam, Magicam, Salutem)
entries.summary: Describes the Fortunam, Magicam and Salutem Forms and their limits compared with Hermetic Arts.

entries.title: The Language of Adam
entries.summary: Fluency in Adamic gives the speaker a lasting Arcane Connection to anything he can name or that is in earshot, and even partial knowledge boosts the Penetration multiplier against targets with Magic Resistance; naming something also shapes its destiny.
quotes: has at least a score of 5 in the Dead Language (Adamic) Ability
receives a +1 bonus to his Penetration multiplier whenever he uses his magic on a target with Magic Resistance

entries.title: Story Hook: The Language of Innocence
entries.summary: Option for a Gifted child raised without language influences to begin with a limited, undevelopable score in Dead Language (Adamic) that can be taught on to others.
quotes: may begin with a score of 2 in Dead Language (Adamic)

entries.title: The Tower of Babel
entries.summary: Describes the research route to Adamic: become fluent in two of the four ancient root languages and reconstruct their common ancestor, which also demands a minimum Area Lore for the region.
quotes: the character must first become fluent in two of these four ancient languages via linguistic research
gain the required Area Lore score of 5

entries.title: Adamic Writing
entries.summary: A character fluent in Adamic who can also write may name things in writing, creating the same Arcane Connection as speaking the name; inscribing the mark of Cain additionally ties the target to Cain's destiny.
quotes: who have a score of 1 in Artes Liberales

entries.title: Finding Cain
entries.summary: Ways to learn Adamic from Cain: slow Exposure from his muttering, tutoring him by listening to his confessions, or coercing him with holy things, with the warning that slaying Cain passes his curse to the killer.
quotes: through exposure to Cain's bizarre manner of speaking, they can pick up experience points in the language

entries.title: Christian Mysticism
entries.requires: Character aligned with the Divine realm
entries.summary: Introduces the mystic as a personal, non-institutional path to God, distinguishes contemplative and monistic mysticism and their dangers, and states that mystics must be Divine-aligned and that their Warping takes the form of Divine Ascent.
quotes: Both forms of mysticism require the character to be aligned with the Divine realm.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine Holy Traditions

entries.title: Contemplative Mysticism
entries.requires: Positive Pious Personality Trait; association with the Divine realm; no Sinful Personality Traits
entries.summary: Describes the contemplative path of imitating Christ and sets its entry requirements: a positive Pious trait, no Sinful traits and an association with the Divine realm.
quotes: the mystic must possess a positive Pious Personality Trait score

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.40 Sinful Personality Traits

entries.title: Spiritual Paths and Revelations
entries.summary: A contemplative mystic gains new Virtues, Methods, Powers or Supernatural Abilities by following a Spiritual Path: a Path Total is set by the Revelation sought, reduced by the character's Pious score to a Path Target, and met by completing Quest Components of listed values.
quotes: Path Target = Path Total – score in Personality Trait Pious
Total Quest Component Values = Path Total

entries.title: Monistic Mysticism
entries.requires: Flaw: Visions or Major Virtue: True Faith; positive Pious trait; association with the Divine realm
entries.summary: Describes the monistic path, its entry requirements, and its Twilight-Prone-like effect that a single Warping Point forces a test for Divine Ascent, so the mystic learns from Warping experiences rather than Spiritual Paths.
quotes: requires the mystic to possess either the Flaw Visions or the Major Virtue True Faith

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Gloom

entries.title: Advantages of Pursuing Monistic Mysticism
entries.summary: Monistic mystics gain extra experience from practising Holy Abilities (equal to Concentration) and, after Divine Ascent, may roll to integrate a Revelation and choose a benefit such as keeping mundane experience, a new Virtue, substituting Dominion Lore for another Realm Lore, or accepting the Infernal as subordinate to the Divine.
quotes: Intelligence + Concentration + stress die vs. Warping Score + stress die (no botch)
gains experience points equal to her Concentration Ability score rather than 4 experience points

entries.title: Apostles of Apollonius
entries.summary: An elementalist society that favors (Theurgical) Summoning, (Theurgical) Controlling and all four Elementalist Forms, with history and notes on its distribution in 1220.

entries.title: Ikhwan as-Safa' (Brethren of Purity)
entries.summary: An elementalist society whose Arts are Philosophical Summoning, Philosophical Refining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teaching of the Brethren of Purity (grades)
entries.summary: The Brethren advance through four grades with minimum Ability scores; Gifted members learn the society's Arts directly while unGifted members must be initiated.

entries.title: Tulab Ibn Sina
entries.summary: An elementalist society of Islamic physicians whose Arts are Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and all four Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Teachings of Ibn Sina (access to Arts)
entries.summary: Who the Tulab accept as students; Gifted members learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining and the Forms, while unGifted members gain Arts only through Initiation.
quotes: Gifted members of this tradition learn Medicinal Summoning, Medicinal Divining, and all the Elementalist Forms.

entries.title: Pagan Traditions
entries.summary: Introduces faerie hedge wizard traditions, with Favored Abilities that are easier to learn, Initiation Scripts, and the minimum Virtue points and Sympathy Traits needed to build a starting faerie wizard.
quotes: the player must devote at least four points of the character's starting Virtues to a Faerie Method and a Faerie Power

related.text: Chapter 5: Touches of Faerie, Learning Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Borrowers
entries.summary: Faerie bargaining tradition of travelling traders who sell goods to faeries; Favored Arts are Summoning, Bonding, Captivating and Dismissing.
quotes: Summoning, Bonding, Captivating, Dismissing

entries.title: Ollamhain
entries.summary: Irish poet-sage tradition of faerie wizardry; Favored Abilities are Enchantment, Beguile, Dream and Portage.
quotes: Enchantment, Beguile, Dream, Portage

entries.title: Volkhvy
entries.summary: Russian pagan faerie wizards who work communal rites; Favored Abilities are Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure and Grant.
quotes: Evocation, Ceremony, Conjure, Grant

entries.title: Wise Folk
entries.summary: Village wise men and women who ward off the supernatural and mend or injure; Favored Abilities are Empathy, Ware, Weal and Woe.
quotes: Empathy, Ware, Weal, Woe

entries.title: Gematria (Ability)
entries.summary: A Jewish form of the Meditation Holy Method: study a text, then use the lower of Gematria and the book's Quality in place of Meditation; it also enables Shinnui Shem.
quotes: At the end of this time, he uses the lower of either his Gematria score or the book's Quality in place of his Meditation when activating holy powers.

entries.title: Kabbalah (Ability)
entries.summary: The Jewish form of the Invocation Holy Method, and the knowledge used to form and animate a golem.
quotes: Kabbalah is the Jewish form of the Invocation Divine Method and can be used in the same way.

entries.title: Merkavah (Ability)
entries.summary: The Jewish form of the Purity Holy Method, also the study of the names and orders of angels, demons and other beings, used to learn True Names.
quotes: Merkavah is the Jewish form of the Purity Divine Method and can be used in the same way.

entries.title: Gematria: Divination from Texts
entries.summary: Explains how Gematria derives hidden meaning from the Torah by numeric values of Hebrew letters, and the limits when applying it to other books.
quotes: Using other books requires a stress die. Books on Arts or Accelerated Abilities cannot be used.

entries.title: Kabbalah and the Sefirot
entries.summary: Describes practical kabbalah and ties a kabbalist's Kabbalah score to the Sefirah of the Tree of Life he has come to understand.
quotes: so a kabbalist with a score of 5 in Kabbalah has achieved the understanding of tiferet and those with a score of 10 or more achieve understanding of Keter.

related.text: Tree of Life table under Mythic Companion: Kabbalist

entries.title: Benandanti Tradition
entries.summary: The north Italian good walkers: how recruits are summoned, the Ember Day Thursday battles against the malandanti, the Lady of the Game who appoints captains and revives eaten animals.
quotes: The benandanti fight in human form and are armed with bunches of fennel

entries.title: Hounds of God Tradition
entries.summary: The werewolf nightwalkers who raid Hell in wolf form three times a year; includes the two ways of becoming a Hound, notably the toasting ritual that passes the power on to another person.
quotes: the wolf does not drink to the toast, or give thanks for it

entries.title: Kresniki and Kudlaki Tradition
entries.summary: Slavic nightwalkers pairing a community protector, the kresnik, with a sorcerer rival, the kudlak, who steals fertility and may return as a vampire. Covers birth with a caul, the forced Versatile Phantasticum and the effects of a kudlak winning.
quotes: These characters are required to take the Versatile Phantasticum Virtue

entries.title: Mazzeru Tradition
entries.summary: Corsican nightwalkers who fight Infernal witches with asphodel and are also compelled to hunt in dreams, killing animals that foretell the death of villagers; accepting this costs no Flaw but resisting it gives a Story Flaw.
quotes: Mazzeri use stalks of asphodel as weapons.

entries.title: Taltos Tradition
entries.summary: Hungarian nightwalkers who fight in the sky as horses, bulls or flames. Covers the childhood coma and initiation, the battle schedule, recovery by eating, and the fact that most taltós lose their powers at some age.
quotes: Taltós fight in the forms of horses, bulls, or flames

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities (Designing Tradition Virtues)
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: Introduces the system for designing a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of a tradition's magic, usable for player magi Ex Miscellanea and for non-player characters.
quotes: This section provides guidance on how a troupe can design a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of the magic of a tradition in House

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities: The Basics (Casting and Penetration Totals)
entries.summary: How a Supernatural Ability is used: the storyguide sets an Ease Factor, the player rolls a Characteristic plus the Ability, penetration and equivalent spell level are worked out, and raw vis can boost the total.
quotes: Casting Total: Characteristic + Ability + aura modifier + die roll
Penetration Total: Casting Total + Penetration Bonus – Ease Factor
Equivalent Spell Level: 5 x Ability

entries.title: Accelerated Abilities
entries.summary: Introduces Accelerated Abilities, Supernatural Abilities that advance on the Art experience scale and are compared with high Ease Factors such as Mights or spell levels, and lists the few ways they differ from standard Abilities.
quotes: The only other difference between a Supernatural Accelerated Ability and a Supernatural Ability is that the equivalent spell level for an Accelerated Ability is equal to the Casting Total, not (Ability x 5).

entries.title: Designing a Supernatural Ability
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: How to design a Major Supernatural Ability: describe its effect by Range, Duration, Target and base guideline, fix three parameters and let one vary with the Ability score or the Ease Factor achieved, and specify its non-Hermetic invocation.
quotes: All Supernatural Abilities designed by these rules are Major Supernatural Virtues.
All Supernatural Abilities fix three of these parameters as unchangeable, and allow one to vary according to either the score in the Ability or the Ease Factor achieved by the Casting Total.

entries.title: Faerie Methods
entries.requires: Faerie wizard: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Explains that Methods are Supernatural Abilities used with a Faerie Power to perform a rite, and gives guidance for designing new Methods with a Characteristic, a cost and an advantage.

entries.title: Evocation (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Communication that calls on faerie patrons at the cost of a Warping Point or Confidence Point, and lets the user add vis to any rite for a bonus with a limit and botch risk.
quotes: with each pawn spent increasing his Rite Casting Total by 2.

entries.title: Enchantment (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Presence in which the user performs an Ability roll against an Ease Factor tied to the intended magnitude, building up a bonus over several rounds before casting the rite; can also roll a simple die to avoid botching.
quotes: making a roll against an Ease Factor of (the magnitude of the intended effect x 3)

entries.title: Empathy (Faerie Method)
entries.summary: Faerie Method using Stamina that requires spending a Fatigue level on a lengthy trance ritual, and lets the user spend more Fatigue to extend the rite, reset bonus limits and multiply the effect cap from Sympathy Traits.
quotes: Empathy allows him to effectively double the value of the Sympathy Traits that determine his effect level

entries.title: Heron's Art: Mechanica
entries.requires: Virtue: Mechanica of Heron, or Hermetic integration of Heron's Mechanica
entries.summary: Introduces the Mechanica of Heron Supernatural Virtue, how a Gifted character learns it from a surviving practitioner, and why a magus would rather integrate it into Hermetic theory.
quotes: A new Major Supernatural Virtue, Mechanica of Heron, represents the magical techniques described in this chapter.

entries.title: Ability: Mechanica of Heron
entries.summary: The Supernatural Ability covering what mechanica are, how to build them and use them, mainly in the laboratory, with its suggested specialties.
quotes: Inventing Mechanica, Constructing Anima, working with a particular material.

entries.title: Mechanica of Heron: constructing mechanica
entries.summary: How a Mechanician builds and alters ordinary mechanica in a laboratory: a creation total against a creation level based on the effect's magnitude, modifiers for size and time to employ, a cost in Mythic Pounds rather than vis, and a week's study to alter a device's effect.
quotes: Construct Mechanica of Heron Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + aura
Mechanica Creation Level: (3 x Magnitude of Imbued Effect) + modifiers
Creating Mechanica Cost: 1 Mythic Pound per 3 points of Mechanica Creation Level

related.text: ArM5 p.187 auras and magical devices

entries.title: Mechanica of Heron: awakened simulacra (anima)
entries.summary: Rules for building a simulacrum of an animal, working out its Magic Might from size and material, awakening its anima with a cumulative-bonus lab project, and playing the resulting sentient mechanica (traits, Abilities, powers of movement and speech).
quotes: Anima's Magic Might: Size + Material Base Points + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales)
Awaken Anima Total: Intelligence + Mechanica of Heron Ability + (lower of Philosophiae or Artes Liberales) + Aura
Awaken Anima Level: 9 + Magnitude of Anima's Magic Might

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.129 automata powers

entries.title: Opening the Gift (hedge traditions)
entries.summary: A season-long ritual in which a Gifted master Opens an apprentice's Gift to the tradition; if the apprentice already has Supernatural Abilities or Arts, an Opening Total is compared with an Opening Ease Factor, with a worked example.
quotes: It takes one season to Open The Gift, which occupies both the apprentice and the master for the whole season.
Opening Ease Factor: twice apprentice's Supernatural Ability + Art scores (+ 12 if Gift already Open)
unless the Opening Total exceeds twice the Opening Ease Factor the apprentice loses his existing Supernatural Ability and Art Scores

entries.title: Flawed Opening of The Gift
entries.summary: A master who lacks competence in the tradition's Arts and Abilities passes on a Flaw to the apprentice for each shortfall.
quotes: the character must have a score of at least 2 in each Supernatural Ability and Art of the tradition

entries.title: Folk Witch Opening the Gift
entries.summary: Opening a folk witch's Gift follows the general rules with a folk-witch Opening Total and grants seven favored Supernatural Abilities, which troupes can swap for others.
quotes: FOLK WITCH OPENING TOTAL: Int + Folk Witch Magic Theory + Sabbat Bonus

entries.title: Precocious Girls
entries.summary: What a coven can do when it accidentally initiates a Gifted girl as if unGifted: find someone to Open her Gift properly or teach her Abilities without favored status.

entries.title: Enriching a Thing of Virtue
entries.summary: Procedure for Enriching Herbs and Objects of Virtue with a season of magical operation to grant a Virtue to the wearer, including the Magic Lore roll to learn the method, the Enrichment Total, the Virtues conferred, drawbacks and Warping.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Magic Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Enrichment Total: Intelligence + Magic Lore + aura

related.text: ArM5 p.184 Penetration of Supernatural Abilities

entries.title: Hedge Magicians and Enriched Things of Virtue
entries.summary: How ungifted hedge magicians use Enriched Things of Virtue to gain minor powers at the cost of accumulating Warping.
quotes: The mechanics of Enriching a Thing of Virtue allow an unGifted character to acquire minor magical powers.

entries.title: Objects of Virtue
entries.summary: Objects of Virtue derive their Virtues from the same Shape and Material Bonuses magi use, and any vis-bearing item with such a bonus to an Art can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art.
quotes: can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art

entries.title: Trees of Virtue
entries.summary: Trees of Virtue hold 1 to 3 pawns of vis tied to their powers and can be Enriched using only part of the tree, which depletes the tree's magic.
quotes: Enriching this item, or collecting the tree's vis, depletes the tree's magical powers.

entries.title: Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Defixio magic let ancient cultists cast spells on targets they could name without any Arcane Connection, by preparing defixiones; Hermetic integration yields a new Duration and a new Range.

entries.title: Learning Defixio Magic
entries.summary: Sources describing defixiones and a roll that lets a magus realize their effects break the Hermetic limit of needing an Arcane Connection.
quotes: Intelligence + Magic Theory roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: Defixio Lore
entries.summary: Describes the Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability that let a cultist prepare a defixio, with cult Art limits, a day and vis per magnitude, and a roll against an Ease Factor that depends on how well the target is identified.
quotes: The creator must spend one day and expend one pawn of vis per magnitude of the spell or Ability in preparing the defixio.
After the defixio is created, the preparer must roll Intelligence + Defixio Lore + a stress die.
Defixio Lore's Penetration total is equal to the amount that the stress roll exceeds the target Ease Factor.

entries.title: Charms
entries.summary: Explains how a Virtue can be tied to a secret faerie charm through the Charm Flaws, how the charm is lost if shared, and which Virtues may be charmed.
quotes: The Virtue must affect what the character can do, not who he is.
if other characters become party to the charm, the power vanishes like mist in the sunlight

entries.title: Folk Charms
entries.summary: Hedge-magic charm that ends a faerie effect, rolled with Intelligence and Faerie Lore, at the cost of a Fatigue level and a Warping point.
quotes: stress die + Intelligence + Faerie Lore + aura
Activating a folk charm costs a Fatigue level and gives the character a point of Warping.

entries.title: Examples of Charmed Virtues
entries.summary: Sidebar giving example Virtues with the charm that activates each.

entries.title: Rites of Faerie
entries.requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Introduces faerie rites, spontaneous spell-like effects that faerie wizards focus through a Faerie Method and Power.

entries.title: Performing Faerie Rites
entries.requires: Faerie Method, Faerie Power and Sympathy Trait
entries.summary: Procedure for casting a faerie rite: the stress die plus Characteristic, Method, Power and aura gives the level, capped by the applicable Sympathy Traits, with rules for negative Traits, botches, experience, ritual-level rites and the lack of permanent effects.
quotes: Rite Casting Total: stress die + Characteristic + Method + Power + aura modifier
Maximum Rite Level: (Sympathy Traits x 5)

related.text: ArM5 pp.111-114 Hermetic Ranges, Durations and Targets

entries.title: Hermetic Rites
entries.summary: Allows a magus with a Faerie Method and Power to design Hermetic rituals using faerie rite guidelines and the special Faerie Ranges, Durations and Targets, using Method and Power in place of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae.
quotes: the caster may add his scores in the Method and Power instead of Artes Liberales and Philosophiae to his Casting Total

entries.title: Detecting and recognising rune magic
entries.summary: Rune-enchanted objects do not register as magical to Intellego Vim, and active runes are lasting Arcane Connections to the caster, so finding and proving working rune magic takes observation and investigation.
quotes: Because of the way that rune magic changes the nature of its target, objects with active effects do not seem magical to Intellego Vim spells.

entries.title: Dvergar-forged rune items
entries.requires: Contact with the dvergar of Nithavellir
entries.summary: How the faerie dvergar craft rune items on commission: they can do more than human rune wizards, their items resemble Hermetic devices, they work only for the person they were made for, and the price is set afterwards and carries hidden costs.
quotes: items only function for the person for whom they were crafted, though they may be inherited by a blood relative

entries.title: Ability: Rune Magic
entries.requires: Rune Magic study or Virtue: Hermetic Rune Magic
entries.summary: The Arcane Ability covering knowledge of runes: their symbolism, formulating and encrypting rune-script, and copying books on rune magic.
quotes: hiding runes, identifying rune magic, runes associated with a particular Art.

entries.title: Sihr (Summoning and Bargaining with Jinn)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability for summoning a jinni and bargaining it into service. Covers discerning a jinni's Might, the vis cost and Summoning Total, extra summoning time, the Bargain Total against an Ease Factor, botches, and how many jinn may be kept in service.
quotes: Summoning Total: Presence + Sihr + Aura + stress die
Bargain Total: Communication + Bargain + Summoning Strength + stress die
Ease Factor: 18 + Bargain Modifiers

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine ch.5 Mythic Islam

entries.title: Bargain Modifiers (Sahirs)
entries.summary: Table of modifiers to the Ease Factor of a sahir's bargain with a jinni, depending on the scope of the terms, length of service, any duty accepted and vis spent above or below the standard cost.

entries.title: Typical Duties for Sahirs
entries.summary: Examples of simple and onerous duties a sahir may accept to modify a bargain with a jinni.

entries.title: Summon Animals (Supernatural Ability)
entries.summary: An example Supernatural Ability that calls mundane animals from a distance; the Ability score determines how many arrive, and a Communication roll sets how fast they come.
quotes: He must then make a Communication + Summon Animals roll against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: Whistle Up the Wind (Supernatural Ability)
entries.summary: An example Supernatural Ability that creates winds with a Stamina roll, with a table of Ease Factors by wind strength and rules for changing the wind later.
quotes: To invoke the wind, the character literally has to whistle, and makes a Stamina + Whistle Up the Wind roll, against the Ease Factor listed in the table below.

entries.title: Control Fertility (Supernatural Ability)
entries.summary: An example Supernatural Ability that enhances or withdraws fertility in plants, animals and people; the Ability score sets the possible effects and a Presence roll sets how long they last.
quotes: She must then make a Presence + Fertility roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to affect the target with the chosen power for a month

entries.title: Craft Amulets: Shape and Material Bonuses
entries.summary: Lists materials, shapes and colors that give bonuses to enchanting amulets, plus extra bonuses for particular combinations; the total is capped by the crafter's Craft Amulets score.
quotes: The total bonus provided by shapes or materials is limited to the character's Craft Amulets Score.
Forming the amulet from a coin provides an additional +1 bonus.

entries.title: Craft Amulets (Ability and Amulet Creation)
entries.summary: Explains how Minor and Major amulets are made with Touch range and Worn duration, how long they take, the totals used to craft them, and how penetration is handled.
quotes: CRAFT MINOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
CRAFT MAJOR AMULET TOTAL: Dexterity + Craft Amulets + Holy Method + Holy Power + Shape and Material Bonus + Dominion Aura Bonus
The crafter's Craft Amulets Total must be at least double the target level of effect.

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the cunning-folk alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues: Mythic Herbalism and Entreat the Faerie Powers

entries.title: Cunning-Folk Magic
entries.summary: Cunning-folk use the learned magician mechanics with local-language charms, Craft: Charm replacing Artes Liberales in the Lab Total, no horoscope requirement and their own lab assistance rule.
quotes: The cunning-folk substitute the Craft: Charm Ability for Artes Liberales in their Laboratory Total when creating their devices.

entries.title: Curse-Throwing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to cure diseases, lift curses and dispel harmful effects by transferring them to another person, with a Casting Total against an Ease Factor by affliction type, ritual time, Penetration and modifiers for how the recipient is represented; includes a worked example.
quotes: Curse-Throwing Casting Total: Presence + Curse-Throwing + Aura + stress die
Penetration Total: Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus

entries.title: Sin-Eating
entries.summary: Describes Sin-Eating as a cultural form of Curse-Throwing, in which sins of the dying are treated as afflictions to be transferred, usually onto the practitioner.
quotes: The magnitude of the unforgiven sin should be considered to be a Minor, Serious, or Major Affliction as appropriate.

entries.title: Folk Witch Magic Theory
entries.summary: An Arcane Ability analogous to Magic Theory, covering the technical details of folk witch magic and used in kitchen laboratory activities; any character can be taught it.
quotes: Any character can be taught this Ability.

entries.title: Potion Effects
entries.summary: What each Ability's potion does for the drinker: temporary Ability scores and durations derived from the Brew Potency, curse potions, healing potions and shapeshifting.
quotes: with an Ability score equal to the Brew Potency / 5 (round up)

entries.title: Holy Tradition: Franciscans
entries.requires: Tradition: Franciscans (Franciscan friar or Poor Sister)
entries.summary: Treats the Franciscans as a Holy Tradition whose members can develop supernatural Abilities under the guidance of experienced Franciscans. Lists the favored Abilities and restricts membership to friars and Poor Sisters.
quotes: Favored Abilities: Intervention, Meditation, Purity, Understanding.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.47

entries.title: Joining the Franciscan Tradition
entries.summary: How a character becomes a member of the Franciscan tradition, either at character creation (supernatural Virtues balanced by Flaws, with Monastic Vows compulsory) or in play through an invitation from a Mystagogue.
quotes: the Supernatural Virtues that bestow the favored Abilities must be balanced by Flaws in the conventional manner, and Monastic Vows is compulsory.

entries.title: Spirits and Non-Hermetic Magic (Goetic Arts)
entries.summary: Summary of the four Goetic Arts used by non-Hermetic sorcerers to summon, drain, bind and command spirits, and which Realms each is aligned to.
quotes: There are four Goetic Arts — namely Summoning, Ablating, Binding, and Commanding

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, Chapter 11: Ars Goetia

entries.title: Goetic Magic
entries.requires: Possession of the Goetic Arts in question
entries.summary: Lets a magus who has studied the Ars Goetia substitute Rego and Vim scores in Goetic formulae, and bond a spirit as familiar using the Summoning Art.
quotes: a magus may substitute his score in Rego for his score in Summoning, Ablating, Binding, or Commanding

entries.title: The Secrets of the Grigori
entries.requires: Virtue: a Grigori Secret, or integration of Grigori magic
entries.summary: Grigori Secrets are Supernatural Virtues letting a user treat vis of three linked Arts as interchangeable and ignore matching requisites, at the cost of doubled botch dice in Divine or Infernal auras; integration offers a Major Breakthrough to a Hermetic Legacy and a Hermetic Breakthrough to break the Limit of Vis.
quotes: Anyone who uses vis through any of the Secrets in either a Divine or Infernal aura must roll double the usual number of botch dice for the vis.
This qualifies as a Major Breakthrough, requiring 45 breakthrough points.
If the magus wishes to break the Limit of Vis, it requires a Hermetic Breakthrough with 60 breakthrough points.

entries.title: The Chiefs of Ten and their Secrets
entries.summary: Lists the Technique and pair of Forms covered by the Secret of each known Watcher, which is the template for each Grigori Supernatural and Hermetic Virtue.
quotes: Araquiel: Creo, Terram, Corpus
Shamsiel: Rego, Ignem, Vim

entries.title: Hex (Ability)
entries.summary: Rules for cursing an enemy: three ways to activate the Power, a time frame whose delay modifier affects the roll, a Hex total compared to an Ease Factor table of severities, botch results, and how hexes are removed.
quotes: Hex: stress die + Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + modifiers
roll Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + delay modifier
Treat the hex as having a spell level equal to the number of botch dice it approximates multiplied by 10

entries.title: Hex Effects (table)
entries.summary: Table of Ease Factors for a Hex roll, with the severity of the curse (as a number of botch dice) and an example of each.
quotes: | 6+ | Minor (1 botch) | Automatic failure at an important task |

entries.title: Caerfloron's Magical Tradition (Homunculus Wizards)
entries.summary: Describes the magi of Caerfloron as Homunculus Wizards whose magic comes from a manikin made of a Mandrake of Virtue, listing the Virtues and Flaws their tradition grants and the plant-like way they sustain themselves.
quotes: Their magical tradition grants them the Greater Immunity to Deprivation and Faerie Magic Virtues, and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw.

entries.title: Homunculi Wizards
entries.requires: Flaw: Homunculus Wizard (character with The Gift)
entries.summary: Explains hedge wizards who gain a faerie version of The Gift through a bond with a homunculus: what they can do, their dependence on feeding and hiding the homunculus, and how to build one as a character.
quotes: To play a Homunculus Wizard as a character, take The Gift and the Homunculus Wizard Flaw during character creation.

related.text: House Merinita outer mystery of Faerie Magic

entries.title: Kolduni Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the pagan wizards of the Novgorod Tribunal who use the gruagach Arts, with the required Flaw and favored Abilities.
quotes: Required Flaws: No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Koldun Magic
entries.summary: Koldun magic uses the gruagach mechanics with Koldovali Theory in place of Pictish, a wholly oral tradition, an Arcane Connection Range needing water, a Durable External Soul variant, and a faerie-based Warping progression.
quotes: except the Ability Koldovali Theory replaces Pictish Language in the relevant formulae
The kolduni have access to the Arcane Connection Range, which adds +4 Magnitudes to a spell's level.

entries.title: The Mercurian Rituals (overview)
entries.requires: Access to Mercurian Ritual Lab Texts
entries.summary: Introduces the Cult of Mercury's non-Hermetic ritual Lab Texts and the translation work needed to reinvent them as Hermetic rituals.

entries.title: Hermetic Versions of the Mercurian Rituals
entries.summary: Introduces the list of recoverable Cult of Mercury rituals that can be reinvented as non-Hermetic Hermetic rituals.

entries.title: Learning the True Names of Angels (Merkavah Total)
entries.summary: A kabbalist fasts and prays over seasons, spending long-term fatigue and accumulating points against the target's Might until its True Name is revealed, giving a Holy Connection and a Penetration bonus.
quotes: MERKAVAH TOTAL: Stamina + Merkavah + Adjuration + Ceremony Bonus + Dominion Aura
EASE FACTOR: Target's Might Score
provides a +5 bonus to his Penetration modifier when affecting the being

entries.title: Dangers of Studying Merkavah Alone
entries.summary: A student studying or using Merkavah alone must pass a Personality Stress Roll each season or become obsessed; a botch attracts Infernal attention.
quotes: the character must make a Disciplined Personality Stress Roll against Ease Factor 9.

entries.title: Mythic Herbalism Ease Factor Table
entries.summary: Table of Ease Factors for the healing effects, poisons and physical-bonus potions that a Mythic Herbalism user can brew.

entries.title: Mythic Herbalism
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability for brewing healing poultices, poisons and potions of physical bonuses: preparation time scales with the Ease Factor, extra doses raise the Ease Factor, and an Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism roll decides success. Describes expiry, duration and stacking limits.
quotes: a number of days equal to one-third the Ease Factor of the intended effect
the Ease Factor is increased by one for each additional dose
roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor

entries.title: Processions of the Dead
entries.summary: Nightwalkers escort the dead and can fight, intimidate or question ghosts; intimidation and questioning use opposed-style Ease Factors keyed to the ghost's traits and the length of answer wanted.
quotes: Presence + Leadership roll against an Ease factor of 6 + the ghost's Brave score

entries.title: Celebratory Processions
entries.summary: Feasts and celebrations are spiritual regeneration that reduce Long Term Fatigue after waking, and the same rituals can help with Long Term Fatigue from other causes.
quotes: Feasting is an act of spiritual regeneration that reduces the level of the nightwalker's Long Term Fatigue after waking

entries.title: Trollsynir Tradition
entries.requires: Tradition: Trollsynir (Virtue: Giant Blood, Flaw: No Tattoo Magic)
entries.summary: Overview of the Norse trollsynir, an alternate tradition using the gruagach Arts, with their required Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Giant Blood, No Tattoo Magic

entries.title: Trollsynir Magic
entries.summary: Trollskap works like gruagach magic with the Jotnar language replacing Pictish and no tattoo magic; overuse turns the trollson into a troll via Warping, and Initiation Scripts favor heroic deeds.
quotes: Any requirement for a score in the Pictish language is replaced with the Jotnar language

entries.title: Wondrous Items (craftsman-made minor enchantments)
entries.summary: How a craftsman with Touched by (Realm) makes a non-Hermetic wondrous item for a specific customer: limits on its single effect, its Craft Level built from a base plus the magnitude and daily uses, how Workshop Total progress accumulates over seasons, helper limits, Arcane Connection to the recipient and verbal triggers.
quotes: Base Supernatural Item Craft Level: 12 + Magnitude of Hermetic Effect + Modifier for Number of Uses per Day
To create wondrous items, a character must have the Major Supernatural Virtue Touched by (Realm).
Wondrous items have no Penetration scores and cannot affect anyone with even the slightest Magic Resistance.

related.text: ArM5 p.110 Shape and Material Bonus chart

entries.title: Craftsmen Supernatural Virtues (Eye of Hephaestus, Touched by (Realm), Crafter's Healing)
entries.requires: Virtue: Eye of Hephaestus, Touched by (Realm) or Crafter's Healing
entries.summary: Sidebar describing three craftsman-only Supernatural Virtues and the rolls they use: judging an item's quality and magic, enabling wondrous items, and the Crafter's Healing Ability for healing wounds at a cost in fatigue and Warping.
quotes: make a Perception + Awareness + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Make a Presence + Crafter's Healing + stress die roll against an Ease Factor equal to the Improvement Ease Factor determined by the Wound Recovery Table (ArM5, page 179).

entries.title: Banishing (Donatores)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Accelerated Ability that expels creatures of one realm from a designated area for a Sun duration, with an Ease Factor depending on area size and a re-entry roll for the banished creature that reduces its Might. Includes a worked example.
quotes: Banishing Total: stress die + Presence + Banishing + aura
the default Ease Factor is Near Range, which is defined as the area within 10 paces of the character
Stamina + (Realm) Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 12

related.text: ArM5 p.148 Weight of a Thousand Hells
RoP: The Infernal p.34 True Names

entries.title: Ability: Ceremony (group effort)
entries.summary: The Supernatural Ability that lets a group combine totals: each participant adds Characteristic plus Ability to the focus character's total, with a leader limiting contributors and a penalty if there is no leader; it can also boost seasonal activities.
quotes: Ceremony Bonus: Characteristic + Ability total of each participant
All participants add their totals of the appropriate Characteristic + Ability to the focus character's total.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.36 Ceremony

entries.title: Chthonic Magic
entries.requires: Supernatural Ability: Chthonic Magic (lineage, tradition, societas, Hermetic Virtue or Mystery Cult)
entries.summary: Low magic associated with underworld gods and night spirits that is ambiguously Infernal: the magus is attuned to Magic and Infernal auras, can use Infernal vis safely and maleficia Ranges/Durations/Targets, and gains a doubled lowest Art after a sinful act.
quotes: Finally, a chthonic magus may always add his lowest Art score to his Lab Total or Casting Total twice
The chthonic magus becomes attuned to both Magical and Infernal auras, and so gains Warping Points from neither, and the benefits of both.

entries.title: Comprehend Magic (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability for analysing the magic in an object, person, aura or vis. A Comprehension Total is compared to an Ease Factor by source of magic, with more rounds of study revealing more, and the insight boosts the user's spells and lab work against the studied target.
quotes: Comprehension Total: Perception + Comprehend Magic + stress die
The observer may add twice his Comprehend Magic score to the Casting Total of any spontaneous Muto, Perdo, or Rego Vim spell used against the object or creature studied

entries.title: Craft Magic (Rusticani)
entries.summary: Lets a character craft an object in place of casting an effect, with shape and material bonuses capped by his Craft score, and also to make charged items and lesser enchantments of vis-containing objects without spending a season. Four applications, each with its own time and level rules and worked examples.
quotes: though this bonus cannot exceed his Craft score
Use the character's Casting Total or the result of the Supernatural Ability roll as if it were a Lab Total to determine the effect's level and the number of charges
the level of the invested effect cannot exceed five times the number of pawns of vis in the object

related.text: RoP: The Divine pp.137-138 Craft Amulets

entries.title: Venatores (demon-hunters)
entries.summary: Describes the Venatores, magi who hunt demons and pass on their lore as an advanced apprenticeship, and how demon-slaying earns them a Venator Reputation and a high Hierarchy Score.
quotes: Each demon they defeat increases their poor Reputation among demons, so that Venatores usually have a powerful Hierarchy Score.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, House Quaesitor, Deals with Devils

entries.title: Vis and hedge wizards: detecting vis
entries.summary: Introduces how hedge wizards may use and detect vis, leading into the Magic Sensitivity and non-supernatural detection methods.

entries.title: Dream Interpretation (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability used either as a Holy Method for activating powers or as direct divination from dreams, with a preparation ritual, hours of contemplation and an Intelligence roll against an Ease Factor based on an equivalent Hermetic spell.
quotes: He may then make an Intelligence + Dream Interpretation roll.
The Ease Factor is the level of the equivalent Momentary non-ritual Intellego Hermetic spell.

entries.title: Faerie Ceremony
entries.summary: A Faerie Supernatural Ability that lets a group join a focus character in a faerie effect, adding a group modifier and each participant's Characteristic plus Ability or Method to the focus character's total.
quotes: Group Modifier: total Ceremony scores – number of participants

entries.title: Learning Faerie Abilities
entries.requires: Strong alignment to the Faerie realm (Sympathy Traits and Faerie Rank)
entries.summary: Describes how characters aligned to Faerie learn Faerie Supernatural Abilities and Arts like Gifted characters learn Magic Abilities, with experience limited by Faerie Rank and easier study of a tradition's four Favored Abilities.
quotes: the sum of the character's strongest positive and negative Sympathy Traits must equal at least 5 at the start of the season for him to learn a new Ability in this way

related.text: ArM5 p.166 Gifted characters learning Magic Abilities

entries.title: Faerie Wizardry Overview
entries.summary: Introduces faerie wizards, or faerie hedge wizards, who use faerie rites and faerie bargaining, and the traditions that teach their Abilities and Arts.

entries.title: May
entries.summary: May labors and festivals, including May Day fires that protect stock against hedge witch curses and Beltaine rituals that can hex magi who have let their Parma Magica lapse outside their Aegis.
quotes: Many peasants run their cattle or sheep between two May Day fires, to defend them against the curses of hedge witches
The Beltaine rituals can hex those who practice magic

entries.title: Favored Abilities
entries.summary: Defines Favored Abilities, a group of Supernatural Abilities that do not penalize each other's Source Quality for learning, and states which Abilities are favored for magi Ex Miscellanea.
quotes: Magi Ex Miscellanea treat the Hermetic Arts and the Supernatural Ability of their tradition as Favored Abilities.

entries.title: Folk Dancer (Communal Dance Magic)
entries.summary: A vestigial communal magical tradition in which a troupe of folk dancers performs a long dance, each passing a Dexterity + Carouse roll, to create a minor magical effect; troupes know only a few fixed dances negotiated at character creation.
quotes: A troupe of a dozen or more folk dancers, who all make Dexterity + Carouse rolls of 9+ can perform a dance

entries.title: Cursewood: Forest Lore and communing with the forest spirit
entries.requires: Ability: Forest Lore (Guardians of the Forest)
entries.summary: A table of what a character with Forest Lore learns or can do in a foreign forest at each Ability score from 3 upward, from learning the spirit's name to being automatically judged worthy.
quotes: can try to commune with the forest spirit, but as this is a foreign place the character must have an Ability level of at least 3 to have any effect.
Character may find vis, although it is vis sordida.

related.text: Guardians of the Forest p.37 Forest Lore

entries.title: Guan king magic (meceny)
entries.summary: Community-ceremony magic of the Guan kings: it cannot fail or botch when the traditional formulae are used, and every meceny can perform a fixed set of effects with village help plus two minor effects unique to his tribe.
quotes: The magic of Guan kings is performed with community ceremonies, and cannot fail or botch, provided the ancient and tested formulae are used.
All meceny can perform the following effects, if assisted by their villages:

related.text: ArM5 p.153 Coerce the Spirits of the Night

entries.title: Holy Music (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability tied to the Holy Method of Meditation: the character sings a devotional song, rolling Presence + Music against an ease factor, and uses Presence to determine the effect; distractions require a Concentration roll.
quotes: You must sing a devotional song, rolling your Presence + Music vs. an ease factor based on the circumstances.

related.text: Instruments of God, Holy Methods and Traditions

entries.title: Infernal Blessing
entries.summary: Explains how a Minor or Major Infernal Blessing grants a pool of unholy effect levels designed like maleficia, with a cap per effect, plus a list of example blessings, Warping Points and a Reputation gain.
quotes: If this is a Major Virtue, you receive 120 levels of effects, and the maximum level of an effect is level 60.
Taking this Virtue also gives the character 3 Warping Points

entries.title: Ceremony (Infernal group rituals)
entries.summary: Lets a group of infernalists add their Characteristic and Ability or Method scores to a focus character's total, with a leader or a group modifier based on their Ceremony scores.
quotes: Group Modifier: Total Ceremony scores – 13
which for Infernal ceremonies must always number 13 (12 participants and the focus character)

entries.title: Corruption (Ability)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability for subverting others through ceremonial influence, written works and corrupted teaching; victims may resist with a Perception + Infernal Lore roll against the corrupter's total.
quotes: roll a die (stress or simple, depending on the situation) and add her Communication and Corruption scores
Perception + Infernal Lore roll against this total

entries.title: Infernal Sacrifice
entries.summary: Ritual sacrifices add a bonus to an infernalist's effect total depending on the victim, at the cost of about an hour of ritual.
quotes: | animal, black | +6 |
| human, innocent | +10 |

entries.title: The Ba'al Ov (Jewish Summoning Tradition)
entries.summary: A Jewish necromantic tradition that uses the Summoning, Commanding and Binding Goetic Arts, forcing spirits to manifest through objects such as corpses and skulls rather than simple circles.
quotes: use the Summoning, Commanding, and Binding Goetic Arts as presented in Realms of Power: The Infernal, pages 114–119.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, pp.114-119

entries.title: Mythic Alchemists Tradition
entries.summary: Overview of the mythic alchemist alternate tradition and its required Virtues, Flaws, Arts and Abilities.
quotes: Required Virtues and Flaws: Mythic Alchemy, Laboratory Magician, and No Text Casting

entries.title: Mythic Alchemy and Mythic Herbalism (Learned Magician Virtues)
entries.requires: Virtue: Mythic Alchemy or Mythic Herbalism
entries.summary: The opening of the learned-magician Virtues, including the extended rules behind Mythic Alchemy (formulae, reagents, alterations, vis limits, craft preparation) and Mythic Herbalism (concoction Ease Factor table for healing, poisons and potions).
quotes: Briefly, a formula is invented in a season by acquiring 5 experience points.
At the end of the process, the player must roll the character's Intelligence + Mythic Herbalism against the target Ease Factor.

entries.title: Sin-Eating
entries.summary: Describes Sin-Eating as a cultural variant of Curse-Throwing, treating a sin as an affliction of Minor, Serious or Major magnitude.
quotes: The magnitude of the unforgiven sin should be considered to be a Minor, Serious, or Major Affliction as appropriate.

entries.title: Nightwalker (Virtue powers and limitations)
entries.summary: The Nightwalker Virtue lets a character stray as a phantasticum, listing the powers it grants (Second Sight, tangible or intangible form, animal shapes, speaking to sleepers) and its duties and limitations such as a vulnerable body and shared injuries.
quotes: The character may make his spiritual form tangible or intangible using a Stamina + Concentration roll.

entries.title: Sense Passions (Ability)
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability to read emotions and Personality Traits, locate strong passions nearby, detect tarnished auras and sense incorporeal spirits, with Ease Factors for each use.
quotes: Sense Passions: stress die + Perception + Sense Passions + aura
A Perception + Sense Passions roll against an Ease Factor of 9

related.text: ArM5 p.67 Sense Holiness and Unholiness
Realms of Power: The Divine p.38

entries.title: Siren Song (Seirenes)
entries.summary: A Major Virtue letting the character command those who hear her music, resolved as a Communication + Music roll against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus table by command severity. Limits help from other musicians and explains how it combines with Enchanting Music.
quotes: A successful roll of Communication + Music versus the target's Stamina roll allows the character to issue a command to any individual or group who hears the music
No more than two musicians' scores can assist the singer in performing a song

entries.title: Mercurian Spell Mastery Abilities
entries.summary: Exclusive Spell Mastery special abilities available to members of the Cult of Mercury.
quotes: The first time in a session that the caster botches a roll for this spell or fails the casting roll by exactly one point, she gains 5 experience points toward Mastery of this spell.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.99-100

entries.title: Summoning Faeries
entries.summary: Sidebar comparing the other Summoning arts that can call faeries or spirits: (Spirit) Summoning, (Elemental) Summoning and Sihr.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.114-115

entries.title: Warding (Columbae)
entries.summary: The Columbae's Accelerated Ability for drawing chalk circles that ward away a subset of one Form. The Warding Total acts as a Casting Total for natural targets and as Penetration against beings with Might, but is useless against Magic Resistance without Might.
quotes: Warding Total: stress die + Stamina + Warding + aura
a ward against objects made of wood requires a Warding Total of at least 30

related.text: ArM5 p.114 Ring Duration / Circle Target

entries.title: Story Seed: The Foundation Charm
entries.requires: Storyguide use of foundation charms or witch bottles
entries.summary: Describes foundation charms and witch bottles guarding halls, with default Hermetic-equivalent statistics for a witch bottle when Hedge Magic is not available.
quotes: assume that the bottles can detect the magical power to curse (InVi 10, Penetration 5) as well as the Gift (InVi 15, Penetration 0)
